a: Veibbaet ema, rav deamar kerabbi yehoshua. detanya, rabbi yehoshua omer: kol hazzevachim shebbattora ben shennitma basar vechelev kayyaym, ben shennitma chelev uvasar kayyaym — zorek et haddam.
Nazir veose fesach, nitma chelev uvasar kayyaym — zorek et haddam. nitma basar vechelev kayyaym — en zorek et haddam, veim zarak — huretza.
Nitmeu habbealim bemet — lo yizrok, veim zarak — lo huretza.
Bammukedashin eno ken vechulei. matnitin manni?

Rabbi yehoshua hi. detanya, rabbi yehoshua omer: kol hazzevachim shebbattora shennishtayyer mehen kezayit basar o kezayit chelev — zorek et haddam. kachatzi zayit basar vechachatzi zayit chelev — en zorek et haddam.
Uvaola, afillu kachatzi zayit basar vechachatzi zayit chelev — zorek et haddam, mippene shekkullah kalil. uvammincha, af al pi shekkullah kayyemet — lo yizrok.
Mincha may avidte? amar rav pappa: minchat nesachim. salka datach amena, kevan deka atya mikkoach zevach — kegufeh dezevach dame. ka mashma lan.
Chelev mena lan? amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi yishmael, umatu ba mishshum rabbi yehoshua ben chananya, deamar kera: "vehiktir hachelev lereach nichoach laAdonai", chelev — af al pi sheen basar.
Ashkechan chelev. yoteret hakkaved ushete chelayot, mena lan?
Hecha amrinan dezarkinan? middekatane: uvammincha af al pi shekkullah kayyemet — lo yizrok. mincha hu dela, aval yoteret hakkaved ushete hakkelayot — shappir dame, mena lan?
Rabbi yochanan dideh amar, amar kera: "lereach nichoach" — kol sheatta maale lereach nichoach.

Veitzterich lemichtav chelev veitzterich lemichtav "reach nichoach", dei ketav rachamana chelev, hava amena: chelev — in, yoteret hakkaved ushete hakkelayot — la, ketav rachamana: "lereach nichoach". vei ketav rachamana: "lereach nichoach", have amena: kol haolin lereach nichoach, vaafillu mincha, ketav rachamana chelev.
Mishna nitma kahal o rubbo, o shehayu hakkohanim temeim vehakkahal tehorim — yaasu betumea. nitma miut hakkahal — hattehorin osin et harishon, vehattemein osin et hashsheni.

Gemara tanu rabbanan: hare shehayu yisrael temein vechohanim uchele sharet tehorin, o shehayu yisrael tehorin vechohanim uchele sharet temein, vaafillu yisrael vechohanim tehorin uchele sharet temein — yaasu betumea, sheen korban tzibbur chaluk.
Amar rav chisda: lo shanu ella shennitma hassakkin bitme met, derachamana amar: "bachalal cherev", cherev hare hu kechalal,
Veka metamme legavra, demeikkara ki mitavid — betumeat hagguf decharet ka mitavid.

Aval nitma hassakkin betumeat sheretz, devasar hu dimtammeya leh, legavra la metammeya leh. tehorin — aved, temein — la aved, mutav yeachel betumeat basar belav, veal yeachel basar betumeat hagguf shehu becharet.
Alma kasavar rav chisda: tumea dechuya hi betzibbur. vechen amar rabbi yitzchak: tumea dechuya hi betzibbur.
Verava amar: afillu temein name avdi. may tama, dichtiv: "vehabbasar asher yigga bechol tame lo yeachel baesh yissaref vehabbasar kol tahor yochal basar".

Kol hecha dela karenan beh "vehabbasar asher yigga bechol tame lo yeachel", la karenan beh "vehabbasar kol tahor yochal basar". kol hecha dekarenan beh "vehabbasar asher yigga bechol tame lo yeachel", karenan beh "vehabbasar kol tahor yochal basar".
Ittemar. hare shehayu yisrael mechetza tehorin umechetza temein. rav amar: mechetza al mechetza kerov. verav kahana amar: mechetza al mechetza eno kerov.
Rav amar mechetza al mechetza kerov: hallalu osin leatzman, vehallalu osin leatzman. verav kahana amar mechetza al mechetza eno kerov: tehorin osin et harishon, utemein osin et hashsheni.
Ikka deamri, amar rav kahana: mechetza al mechetza eno kerov — tehorin osin et harishon,
b: Utemein en osin lo et harishon velo et hashsheni. barishon la avdi — dela havu rubba. bashsheni la avdi — dela havu miuta.
Tenan: nitma kahal o rubbo, o shehayu hakkohanim temein vehakkahal tehorim — yease betumea. rubbo hu deavdi betumea, aval palga ufalga la avdi barishon. kashya lerav!
Amar lach rav: rubba avdi kullehu betumea, palga ufalga — hallalu osin leatzman vehallalu osin leatzman.

Hachi name mistabbera, dekatane sefa: nitma miut hakkahal, tehorin osin et harishon utemein osin et hashsheni. miut hu deavdi bashsheni, aval palga ufalga — la. veavdi barishon, vehallalu osin leatzman vehallalu osin leatzman.

Veella kashya lerav kahana! amar lach rav kahana: nitmeu miut hakkahal — tehorin osin et harishon utemein osin et hashsheni. ha palga ufalga — tehorin osin et harishon, aval temein enan osin lo et harishon velo et hashsheni.
Hatinach lelishshana batra derav kahana. ella lehach lishshana deamar rav kahana: tehorim osin et harishon, utemein osin et hashsheni, may ikka lememar?
Amar lecha rav kahana: hu haddin daafillu palga ufalga name — tehorin osin et harishon, utemein osin et hashsheni. vehay dekatane miut hakkahal, ayyeyde ditna resha "rubbo" — tena name sefa "miuto".
Tanya kevoteh derav, tanya kevoteh derav kahana kitre lishshane. tanya kevoteh derav: hayu yisrael mechetza tehorin umechetza temein, hallalu osin leatzman vehallalu osin leatzman.
Tanya kelishna kamma derav kahana: hare shehayu yisrael mechetza tehorin umechetza temein, tehorin osin et harishon utemein osin et hashsheni.
Vetanya kelishshana batra derav kahana: hare shehayu yisrael mechetza tehorin umechetza temein, tehorin osin et harishon, utemein enan osin lo et harishon velo et hashsheni.

Lerav ulelishshana batra derav kahana, ha detana "tehorin osin et harishon utemein et hashsheni", hechi metartzi la? kegon shehayu yisrael mechetza tehorin umechetza temein, venashim mashlimot lattemeim.
Vekasavar: nashim barishon reshut. dal nashim mittemein, vehavu lehu temein miuta, umiuta yidchu lefesach sheni.
Lerav ulelishshana kamma derav kahana, ha detanya "tehorin osin et harishon utemein en osin lo et harishon velo et hashsheni", hechi metartzi la?
Rav metaretz la, kegon shehayu yisrael mechetza temein umechetza tehorin, venashim odfot al hattehorim, vekasavar: nashim barishon chova, uvashsheni reshut.
Barishon la avdi — dehave leh miut, umiuta la avdi barishon. uvashsheni la avdi — dal nashim minnayyhu vehavu lehu palga ufalga, ufalga la avdi bashsheni.

Ulerav kahana daamar: palga name avdi bashsheni, hachi metaretz la: kegon shehayu yisrael mechetza tehorin umechetza temein, venashim mashlimot lattehorin. vekasavar: nashim barishon chova uvashsheni reshut.
Barishon la avdi — dehavu lehu palga ufalga, ufalga barishon la avdi, bashsheni name la avdi — dal nashim minnayyhu min hattehorin havu lehu temein rubba, verubba la avdi bashsheni.

Ulerav kahana, ha detanya: hare shehayu yisrael mechetza tehorin umechetza temein, hallalu osin leatzman vehallalu osin leatzman, hechi metaretz la? amar lach rav kahana: tannae hi. ikka leman deamar: mechetza al mechetza kerov, veikka leman deamar: mechetza al mechetza eno kerov.

Gufa. hare shehayu yisrael mechetza tehorin umechetza temein, hallalu osin leatzman vehallalu osin leatzman. hayu temein odfin al hattehorin, afillu echad — yaasu betumea, lefi sheen korban tzibbur chaluk.
Rabbi elazar ben matya omer: en hayyachid machria et hatztzibbur letumea, shenneemar:

a: "Lo tuchal lizboach et happasach beachad shearecha".
Rabbi shimon omer: afillu shevet echad tame ushear kol hashshevatim tehorim — hallalu osin leatzman vehallalu osin leatzman. may tama derabbi shimon, kasavar: shevet echad ikkeri kahal.

Rabbi yehuda omer: afillu shevet echad tame ushear kol hashshevatim tehorin — yaasu betumea, sheen korban tzibbur chaluk. rabbi yehuda savar: shevet echad ikkeri kahal. vehavu lehu palga ufalga, veen korban tzibbur chaluk — veavdi kullehu betumea.
Ittemar: hayu yisrael mechetza tehorin umechetza temein, amar rav: metammein echad mehen besheretz.
Veammay? nibedu hane lechodayyhu vehane lechodayyhu, deha amar rav: hallalu osin leatzman, vehallalu osin leatzman! amri: hacha bemay askinan, kegon shehayu temein odfin al hattehorin echad.

I hachi, havu lehu rubba temeim? nibedu kullehu betumea! savar la kerabbi elazar ben matya, deamar: en hayyachid machria et hatztzibbur letumea. i hachi, hadar kusheyayn leducheteh: nibedu hane lechodayyhu vehane lechodayyhu!
Ella hachi kaamar: i ikka tanna desavar la ketanna kamma, deamar: palga ufalga la avdi kullehu betumea, vesavar la kerabbi yehuda, deamar: en korban tzibbur chaluk — metammein echad mehen besheretz.
Veulla amar: meshallechin echad mehen lederech rechoka. vitammeennu besheretz!
Kasavar: shochatin vezorkin al teme sheretz.
Vitammeennu bemet! madchehu atta mechagigato.
Hasheta name madchehu atta mippischo! efshar deaved bashsheni.
Bemet name, efshar deaved bashshevii dahava leh shemini shello!
Kasavar ulla: kullehu — tashlumin derishon ninhu. dachaze barishon — chaze bechullehu, vechol hecha dela chaze barishon — la chaze bechullehu.
Amar lehu rav nachman: zilu veemaru leh leulla, man tzayet deakar sikkeh umashkeneh verahet.
Ittemar: hayu rubban zavin, umiutan temee metim, amar rav: otan temee metim enan osin lo barishon velo bashsheni.

Rishon la avdi, dehavu miuta, umiuta la avdi barishon. bashsheni name la avdi, kol hecha deavdi tzibbur barishon — aved yachid bashsheni. kol hecha dela avdi tzibbur barishon — la aved yachid bashsheni.

Amar lehu shemuel, zilu emaru leh leabba: "veyaasu vene yisrael et happasach bemoado" may avdat leh? amar lehu, zilu emaru leh: ki havo kullehu zavin may avdat leh? ella kevan dela efshar — la efshar. hacha name, la efshar.
Ittemar: hayu rubban temee metim umiutan zavin,
Rav huna amar: en tashlumin lefesach habba betumea, verav adda bar ahava amar: yesh tashlumin lefesach habba betumea.
Nema beha kamippalgi, deman deamar: en tashlumin lefesach habba betumea, kasavar: tumea dechuya hi betzibbur.
Uman deamar: yesh tashlumin lefesach habba betumea, kasavar: tumea huttera betzibbur.
Amri: la. dechulle alma tumea dechuya betzibbur, uveha peligi: mar savar —
b: Tohora medachaya, tumea la medachaya. umar savar — afillu tumea name medachaya.
Ittemar: hayu shelishitan zavin, ushelishitan tehorin, ushelishitan temee metim — amar rabbi mani bar pattish: otan temee metim enan osin lo et harishon velo hashsheni.

Barishon la avdi: higdilu zavin al hattehorim, dela avdi betumea, have leh temee metim miuta — umiuta la avdi barishon. bashsheni la avdi: nitztzarfu zavin im temee metim, dela avdi barishon, havu lehu rubba — verubba la middechu lefesach sheni.

Mishna happesach shennizrak damo veachar kach noda shehu tame — hatztzitz meratztze. nitma hagguf — en hatztzitz meratztze, mippene sheamru: hannazir veose fesach, hatztzitz meratztze al tumeat haddam, veen hatztzitz meratztze al tumeat hagguf.
Nitma tumeat hattehom — hatztzitz meratztze.
Gemara tama denizrak veachar kach noda, aval noda veachar kach nizrak — lo meratztze.
Ureminhu: al ma hatztzitz meratztze? al haddam veal habbasar veal hachelev shennitma, ben beshogeg ben bemezid, ben beones ben beratzon, ben beyachid ben betzibbur!
Amar ravina: tumeato, ben beshogeg ben bemezid — huretza. zerikato, beshogeg — huretza, bemezid — lo huretza.
Rabbi shela amar: zerikato, ben beshogeg ben bemezid — huretza. tumeato, beshogeg — huretza, bemezid — lo huretza.
Ella ha dekatane: ben beshogeg ben bemezid, hachi kaamar: nitma beshogeg, uzerako ben beshogeg ben bemezid — huretza.
Veha dekatane: dam shennizrak veachar kach noda, tama denizrak veachar kach noda, aval noda veachar kach nizrak — la, hu haddin daafillu noda veachar kach nizrak.
Vehay dekatane nizrak veachar kach noda, mishshum devae lemitne sefa: nitma hagguf en hatztzitz meratztze, daafillu nizrak veachar kach noda — la, katane resha name: nizrak veachar kach noda.

Nitma tumeat hattehom vechulei. bae rame bar chama: kohen hameratztze bekorbenotehen, huttera lo tumeat hattehom, o la? mi amrinan ki gemiri tumeat hattehom — bivalim, bechohen — la gemiri, o dilma: bezivcha gemiri, la shena bechohen vela shena bivalim.
Amar rava: ta shema, detane rabbi chiyyay: lo amru tumeat hattehom ella lemet bilvad. met lemaote may? lav lemaote tumeat hattehom desheretz?
Uvemay askinan? i nema bivalim, uveman — i benazir, mi mahane beh? "ki yamut met alav" amar rachamana.
Ella beose fesach. hanicha leman deamar en shochatin vezorkin al temee sheretz. ella leman deamar shochatin vezorkin al temee sheretz, hasheta tumea yedua huttera lo, tumeat hattehom lo kol shekken?!
Ella lav — bechohen, ushema minna huttera lo tumeat hattehom!
Amar rav yosef: lo, leolam bivalim, uvefesach. ulemaote tumeat hattehom deziva.
Vetumeat tehom deziva lo meratztze? vehatanya, rabbi yose omer: shomeret yom keneged yom sheshshachatu vezarku aleha

a: Bashsheni shellah, veachar kach raata — enah ochelet, ufetura millaasot pesach sheni.
May tama? lav mishshum dimratztze tzitz? amri: la, mishshum dekasavar rabbi yose: mikkan ulehabba hi metammea.

Vehatanya, rabbi yose omer: zav baal shete reiyyot sheshshachatu vezarku alav bashshevii shello, veachar kach raa, vechen shomeret yom keneged yom sheshshachatu vezarku aleha bashsheni shellah, veachar kach raata — hare ellu metammein mishkav umoshav lemafrea,
Ufeturim millaasot pesach sheni.
Amri: may, lemafrea — midderabbanan.
Veaf rabbi oshaya savar metamme lemafrea midderabbanan. detanya, rabbi oshaya omer: aval zav sheraa bashshevii shello — soter et shellefanav. vaamar leh rabbi yochanan: lo yistor ella yomo!
Mimma nafshach: i kasavar lemafrea hu metamme — afillu kullehu nistor. i kasavar mikkan ulehabba hu metamme — yomo name la nistor! ella ema: lo yistor velo yomo.
Vaamar leh: rabbi yose kae kevotach. veha rabbi yose omer: metammein mishkav umoshav lemafrea! ella lav, shema minna: metamme lemafrea midderabbanan. shema minna.
Ulerabbi yose, hasheta deamar mikkan ulehabba hu metamme [lemet] bilvad, lemaote may?
Nifshot minna, divchohen vehutera lo tumeat hattehom.
Amri: leolam bivalim uvefesach, vekasavar: en shochatin vezorkin al temee sheretz, veitzterich lemaote.
Ella lerabbi yose, zava gemura hechi mashkachat la?
Beshofaat. i baet ema: kegon sheraata kol shene ben hashshemashot.

Bae rav yosef: kohen hameratztze betamid, huttera lo tumeat hattehom o la? im timtza lomar kohen hameratztze bekorbenotehen (shel nazir veose fesach) huttera lo tumeat hattehom, kohen hameratztze betamid may? mi amrinan ki gemiri tumeat hattehom — befesach, betamid la gemiri. o dilma yalef tamid mippesach.
Amar rabba, kal vachomer: uma bemakom shello huttera lo tumea yedua — huttera lo tumeat hattehom, makom shehuttera lo tumea yedua —
b: Eno din shehuttera lo tumeat hattehom!
Amri: umi dayyninan kal vachomer mehalacha? vehatanya, amar lo rabbi eliezer: akiva, etzem kisora halacha, reviit dam kal vechomer, veen danin kal vachomer mehalacha!
Ella amar rava: yalef "moado" "moado" mippesach.
Vetumeat hattehom gufa hecha ketiva? amar rabbi elazar, amar kera: "vechi yamut met alav" — bimchuvvevret alav.
Ashkechan nazir. ose fesach menalan? amar rabbi yochanan, amar kera: "bederech rechoka lachem" — bimchuvvevret lachem.
Rabbi shimon ben lakish amar: kederech. ma derech — begaluy, af tumea name — begaluy.
Metivi: e zehu tumeat hattehom? kol shello hikkir bah echad besof haolam. hikkir bah echad besof haolam — en ze tumeat hattehom. lerabbi elazar, deamar: bimchuvvevret alav — ad deyada hu.
Lerabbi yochanan, deamar: "lachem", bimchuvvevret lachem — ad deyadi ba teren.
Lerabbi shimon ben lakish, deamar: kederech — ad deyadi kulle alma.
Ella, tumeat hattehom hilcheta gemiri la, ukera — asmachta bealma.
Amar mar bar rav ashe: lo shanu ella shennoda lo leachar zerika, dechi izderik dam — shappir izderik, aval noda lo lifne zerika — lo meratztze.
Metivi: hammotze met mushekav lerochbo shel derech, litruma — tame. lenazir veose fesach — tahor. vechol tame vetahor — lehabba hu.
Ella i ittemar, hachi ittemar: amar mar bar rav ashe: la tema noda lo leachar zerika hu dimratztze, aval noda lo lifne zerika — lo meratztze, ella afillu noda lo lifne zerika — meratztze.
Gufa. hammotze met mushekav lerochbo shel derech, litruma — tame, lenazir veose fesach — tahor.
Bamme devarim amurim — sheen lo makom laavor. aval yesh makom laavor — af litruma tahor.
Bamme devarim amurim — shemmetzao shalem. aval meshubbar umeforak tahor, shemma ben happerakim avar. uvakkever, afillu meshubbar umeforak tame, mippene shehakkever metzarfo.
Bamme devarim amurim — bimhallech beraglav, aval taun o rachuv — tame, lefi shemmehallech beraglav efshar shello yigga velo yaahil, aval taun o rachuv i efshar shello yigga velo yaahil.
Bamme devarim amurim — betumeat hattehom, aval betumea yedua — tame:
Vee ze hi tumeat hattehom — kol shello hikkir bah echad besof haolam. aval hikkir bah echad besof haolam — en ze tumeat hattehom.
Metzao tamun beteven, beafar, uvitzrorot — hare ze tumeat hattehom. bemayim, baafela, binkike hasselaim — en ze tumeat hattehom. velo amru tumeat hattehom ella lemet bilvad.

Mishna nitma shalem o rubbo — sorfin oto lifne habbira meatze hammaaracha. nitma miuto vehannotar — sorfin oto bechatzrotehen o al gaggotehen meatze atzman. hatztzikanin sorfin oto lifne habbira bishvil lehanot meatze hammaaracha.
Gemara may tama? amar rabbi yose bar chanina: kede levayyeyshan.
Nitma miuto vechulei. ureminhu: vechen mi sheyyatza mirushalayim venizkar sheyyesh beyado besar kodesh, im avar tzofim — sorfo bimkomo, veim lav —

a: Chozer vesorfo lifne habbira meatze hammaaracha!
Amar rav chama bar ukeva: la kashya, kan — beachsenay. kan — bevaal habbayit.
Rav pappa amar: ha veha beachsenay, kan — shehechzik badderech, kan — shello hechzik badderech.

Rav zevid amar: leolam kidamar meikkara — kan beachsenay kan bevaal habbayit, veaf al gav dela hechzik badderech, achsenay kevan delet leh asauhu ketzikanin. ditnan: hatztzikanin sorfin oto lifne habbira bishvil lehanot meatze hammaaracha.
Tanu rabbanan: bau lesorfo bechatzrotehen umeatze hammaaracha — en shomin lahen. lifne habbira umeatze atzman — en shomin lahen.
Bishlama meatze hammaaracha bechatzrotehen en shomin lahen — dilma payyshan minnayyhu, veatu behu lide takkala. ella lifne habbira meatze atzman, may tama la?
Rav yosef amar: shello levayyesh et mi sheen lo. rava amar: mippene hachashad.
May benayyhu? ikka benayyhu deayyti kene vecharyavata, dela chaze lammaaracha.
Tenan hatam: rosh hammaamad haya maamid et hattemein al shaar hammizrach. may tama? amar rav yosef: kede levayyeyshan. rava amar: mippene hachashad.
May benayyhu? ikka benayyhu mefanneki, i name deka gadel shishura.

Mishna happesach sheyyatza o shennitma — yissaref miyyad. nitmeu habbealim o shemmetu — teubbar tzurato, veyissaref beshishsha asar. rabbi yochanan ben beroka omer: af ze yissaref miyyad lefi sheen lo ochlin.
Gemara bishlama tame, ketiv: "vehabbasar asher yigga bechol tame lo yeachel baesh yissaref". ella yotze menalan?
Dichtiv: "hen lo huva et damah el hakkodesh penima". amar lo moshe leaharon: maddua lo achaltem et hachattat? shemma nichnas damah lifnay velifnim. amar lo: lav.

Amar lo: shemma chutz limchitzatah yatzta? amar lo: lav, bakkodesh hayta. amar lo: i bakkodesh hayta vehen lo huva et damah el hakkodesh penima", maddua lo achaltem otah? mikkelal dei nafka, i name ayel damah lifnim — bat serefa hi.
Bishlama nitma, galli rachamana bekadashim kallim, kol shekken bekodshe kadashim. ella yotze, ashkechan kodshe hakkodashim, kadashim kallim menalan? vetu, ha detanya: lan damah,
b: Nishpach damah, yatza damah chutz lakkelaim — dekayyma lan bisrefa, menalan?
Nafka lan midderabbi shimon. detanya, rabbi shimon omer: "bakkodesh baesh tissaref" — limmed al chattat shesserefatah bakkodesh.
En li ella zo bilvad, shear pesule kodshe kadashim veemure kadashim kallim minnayin? talmud lomar: "(vechol) ... bakkodesh ... baesh tissaref".

Ashkechan kodshe kadashim, kadashim kallim menalan? ella: kol pesulo bakkodesh bisrefa, la shena kadashim kallim vela shena kodshe kadashim — gemara gemiri la, vechattat deaharon mishshum maase shehaya kach haya.
Uletanna deve rabba bar avu, deamar: afillu piggul taun ibbur tzura. mena lan?
Yalef "avon" "avon" minnotar.
Venelaf "avon" "avon" mechattat deaharon! amar lach: chattat deaharon ki hay gavvna name ibbur tzura ledorot baaya, vehatam — horaat shaa hayta.

Hasheta deamrinan kol pesule dekodesh bisrefa, la shena dekodshe kadashim vela shena kadashim kallim, gemara gemiri la, "bakkodesh ... baesh tissaref" lema li? hahu mibbee leh shesserefatah bakkodesh.
"Vehabbasar asher yigga bechol tame lo yeachel baesh yissaref", lema li?
Hahu, legufeh itzterich. salka datach amena kol pesule dekodesh, kegon: lan damah, venishpach damah, veyatza damah, venishchata ballayla, devisrefa deletanhu bechullin.
Aval nitma, divchullin name mippesil, ema hoil veitavid beh ovadin dechol — ema la tibbee serefa, vetisge leh bikvura, ka mashma lan.

Nitmeu habbealim o shemmetu teubbar tzuratan vechulei. amar rav yosef: machloket shennitmeu bealim achar zerika, deitchazi basar laachila. aval nitmeu bealim lifne zerika, dela itchazi basar laachila — divre hakkol yissaref miyyad.
Metivi, ze hakkelal: kol sheppesulo begufo — yissaref miyyad. baddam uvabbealim — teubbar tzurato veyetze levet hasserefa.
Katane bealim dumeya dedam: ma dam lifne zerika, af bealim lifne zerika.

Ella i ittemar, hachi ittemar: machloket shennitmeu bealim lifne zerika, dela itchazi basar laachila, dehave leh kifsulo begufo. aval nitmeu bealim leachar zerika, deitchazi basar laachila — divre hakkol pesulo mechamat davar acher, uvaaya ibbur tzura.

Verabbi yochanan amar: af leachar zerika name machloket. veazda rabbi yochanan letameh, deamar rabbi yochanan: rabbi yochanan ben beroka verabbi nechemya amru davar echad, rabbi yochanan ben beroka ha daamaran.
Rabbi nechemya may hi? detanya, rabbi nechemya omer: mippene aninut nisrefa zo, lechach neemar "kaelle".
Veha aninut kilachar zerika havya, vechi isteruf — lealtar (nisteruf).

a: Rabba mosif, af rabbi yose haggelili. detanya, rabbi yose haggelili omer: kol hainyan kullo eno medabber ella befarim hannisrafim uvisirin hannisrafin, lisrof pesulehen abbet habbira, velitten "lo taase" al achilatan.
Amru lo: chattat shennichnas damah lifnay velifnim minnayin? amar lahen: "hen lo huva et damah el hakkodesh penima", mikkelal dei nafek ihi, i name ayel damah — bisrefa.
Verabbi yochanan savar: dam uvasar chada milleta hi. bealim milleta achariti hi.
Mishna haatzamot vehaggidin vehannotar — yissarfu beshishsha asar. chal shishsha asar lihyot beshabbat — yissarfu beshiva asar. lefi sheenan dochin lo et hashshabbat velo et yom tov.

Gemara amar rav mari bar avu amar rabbi yitzchak: atzmot kadashim sheshshimmeshu notar — metammein et hayyadayim, hoil venaasa basis ledavar haasur. nema mesayyay leh: haatzamot vehaggidim vehannotar — yissarfu leshishsha asar.
Hane atzamot hechi dame? illema delet behu moach, lamma bisrefa? nishdinhu! ella peshita, deit behu moach.

I amrat bishlama shimmush notar milleta hi, ammetu lehachi bae serefa. ella i amrat shimmush notar lav milleta hi, lema lehu serefa? nitberinhu venachletze lemoach didhu venisrefeh venishdinhu ledidhu. ella lav shema minna, shimmush notar milleta hi.
Amri: la, leolam ema lach shimmush notar — lav milleta, vekasavar: "bo" bechasher, vaafillu befasul.
Afillu befasul salka datach? veha tenan: aval hammotir battahor vehashshover battame eno sofeg et haarbaim! la kashya, kan — shehayta lo sheat hakkosher, kan — shello hayta lo sheat hakkosher.

Uman tanna deshane leh ben shehayta lo sheat hakkosher lelo hayta lo sheat hakkosher, rabbi yaakov hi. detanya: "veetzem lo tishberu vo", "bo" bechasher velo befasul. rabbi yaakov omer: hayta lo sheat hakkosher venifsal — yesh bo mishshum shevirat haetzem, lo hayta lo sheat hakkosher — en bo mishshum shevirat haetzem. rabbi shimon omer: echad ze veechad ze — en bo mishshum shevirat haetzem.

Metivi: kol atzmot hakkodashim en teunin serefa, chutz meatzmot happesach mippene hattakkala. hane atzamot hechi dame? illema delet behu moach, lema lehu serefa? ella peshita deit behu moach, vei salka datach shimmush notar milleta hi — atzmot kadashim ammay en teunin serefa?

Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: hacha bemay askinan? kegon shemmetzaan chalutzin: atzmot kadashim, deen bahen mishshum shevirat haetzem — kamme denehvo notar chaltzinhu, vela havu shimmush notar, vela bau serefa.
Atzmot happesach, deyesh bahen mishshum shevirat haetzem — levatar denehvo notar hu dechaltzinhu, vehavu lehu shimmush notar, uvau serefa.
Rav zevid amar: hacha bemay askinan? kegon
b: Shemmetzaan tzibburin tzibburin, umehen chalutzin. atzmot kadashim deen bahen mishshum shevirat haetzem — lechullehu hava chaletz lehu veachel lehu, vela bae serefa.
Atzmot happesach deyesh bahen mishshum shevirat haetzem — dilma hane dechaltzinhu, ulehanach la chaltzinhu, uvae serefa.
Amar rav yehuda amar rav: kol haggidin basar, chutz miggide tzavvar.
Tenan: haatzamot vehaggidim vehannotar yissarfu beshishsha asar. hane gidin hechi dame? illema gide vasar — nechlinhu? vei deittotar — hayeynu notar? ella peshita: gide tzavvar.
I amrat bishlama basar ninhu, ammetu lehachi bae serefa. ella i amrat lav basar ninhu — lema lehu serefa? amar rav chisda: lo nitzrecha ella legid hannashe, veallibba derabbi yehuda.
Detanya, rabbi yehuda omer: eno noheg ella beachat, vehaddaat machraat shel yamin.
Veella tifshot desappoke mesappeka leh lerabbi yehuda. dei mippeshit peshita leh, hahi dehettera nechleh, udeissura nishdeyeh — lema leh serefa!
Amar rav ika bar chinnana: kegon shehukkeru ulevassof nitarvu.
Rav ashe amar: lo nitzrecha ella leshummano degid hannashe. detanya: shummano muttar, veyisrael kedoshim hem venohagin bo issur.

Ravina amar: bachitzon, vechidrav yehuda amar shemuel. deamar rav yehuda amar shemuel: shene gidin hen, penimi hassamuch laetzem — asur, vechayyayvin alav. chitzon hassamuch labbasar — asur, veen chayyayvin alav.
Chal shishsha asar vechulei. veammay? nete ase veyidche lo taase!

Amar chizkiyya, vechen tane deve chizkiyya, amar kera: "lo totiru mimmennu ad boker vehannotar mimmennu ad boker baesh tisrofu", sheen talmud lomar "ad boker", ma talmud lomar "ad boker" — litten lo boker sheni lisrefato.
Abbaye amar, amar kera: "olat shabbat beshabbatto", velo olat chol beshabbat, velo olat chol beyom tov.
Rava amar, amar kera: "hu levaddo yease lachem" — "hu" velo machshirav, "levaddo",

a: Velo mila shello bizmannah, habbaa mikkal vachomer.
Rav ashe amar: "shabbaton" deyom tov — ase hu, veen ase doche lo taase vaase.
Mishna kol hanneechol beshor haggadol — yeachel bigdi harach, verashe chenafayim vehassechusim.
Gemara rabba rame, tenan: kol hanneechol beshor haggadol — yeachel bigdi harach, vesheeno neechol — lo. ema sefa: rashe chenafayim vehassechusim. veha hane la mitachli beshor haggadol!
Ella tannae hi, vehachi katane: kol hanneechol beshor haggadol — yeachel bigdi harach, vesheeno neechol — lo. veyesh omrim: af rashe chenafayim vehassechusim.
Rava amar: "ma hen" katane, vehachi katane: kol hanneechol beshor haggadol beshilka — yeachel bigdi harach betzali. uma hen: rashe chenafayim vehassechusim.
Tanya kevoteh derava: kol hanneechol beshor haggadol beshilka — yeachel bigdi harach betzali, uma hen: rashe chenafayim vehassechusim, vegidin harakkin niddonin kevasar.

Ittemar: gidin shessofan lehakeshot, rabbi yochanan amar: nimnin alehen bappesach, resh lakish amar: en nimnin alehen bappesach. rabbi yochanan amar nimnin alehen — batar hasheta azlinan. resh lakish amar en nimnin alehen — batar bassof azlinan.

Etiveh resh lakish lerabbi yochanan: kol hanneechol beshor haggadol — yeachel bigdi harach, uma hen rashe chenafayim vehassechusim. hane in, aval gidin shessofan lehakeshot — la! amar leh: tena hane vehu haddin lehanach. hane may tama — deha mitachli beshor haggadol beshilka, hanach name mitachli beshor haggadol beshilka.

Amar leh rabbi yirmeya lerabbi avin: ki azlat lekammeh derabbi avahu, remi leh: mi amar rabbi yochanan gidin shessofan lehakeshot nimnin alehen bappesach, alma: batar hasheta azlinan? veha bea minneh resh lakish merabbi yochanan: or harosh shel egel harach, mahu sheyyetamme? veamar lo: en metamme. alma: batar bassof azlinan!
Amar leh: dirma lach ha — la chash lekimcheh. ha hadar beh rabbi yochanan legabbe deresh lakish, vaamar leh: al takniteni, shebbilshon yachid ani shone otah.
Mishna hashshover et haetzem bappesach hattahor — hare ze loke arbaim. aval hammotir battahor vehashshover betame — eno loke et haarbaim.
Gemara bishlama motir battahor — detanya: "lo totiru mimmennu ad boker vehannotar mimmennu ad boker vegomer", ba hakkatuv litten ase achar lo taase lomar sheen loke — divre rabbi yehuda.

Rabbi yaakov omer: lo min hashshem hu ze, ella mishshum dehave leh lav sheen bo maase, veen lokin alav. ella shover battame menalan? deamar kera: "veetzem lo tishberu vo", "bo" bechasher velo befasul.

Tanu rabbanan: "veetzem lo tishberu vo", "bo" — bechasher velo befasul. rabbi omer: "bevayit echad yeachel ... veetzem lo tishberu bo". kol harauy laachila — yesh bo mishshum shevirat etzem, vesheen rauy laachila — en bo mishshum shevirat etzem.
May benayyhu? amar rabbi yirmeya: pesach habba betumea ikka benayyhu. leman deamar kasher —
b: Hay pasul. leman deamar rauy laachila — hay name rauy laachila hu.
Rav yosef amar: ki hay gavvna — dechulle alma en bo mishshum shevirat haetzem, derabbi leakkole ka ate, vehay ha pasul hu.
Ella, hayta lo sheat hakkosher venifsal ikka benayyhu. leman deamar kasher — ha kasher hu. leman deamar rauy laachila — ha hasheta lav rauy laachila hu.

Abbaye amar: kulle alma kol ki hay gavvna en bo mishshum shevirat haetzem, may tama? hasheta mihat ha pasul hu. ella, shevirat haetzem mibbeod yom ikka benayyhu. leman deamar kasher — ha kasher hu, leman deamar rauy laachila — hasheta lav bar achila hu,

Metivi, rabbi omer: nimnin al moach shebbarosh veen nimnin al moach shebbakkulit. al moach shebbarosh may tama — hoil veyachol legorro ulehotzio. vei salka datach shevirat haetzem mibbeod yom shappir dame — kulit name, nitbereh mibbeod yom, venappeku lemoach dideh, venimno aleh!

Amar lach abbaye: uletamaych, mishshechashecha name: nayyte gumarta venaychevt aleh venikle, venappeke lemoach dideh, venimmene aleh. deha tanya: aval hassoref baatzamot vehamechattech begidin — en bo mishshum shevirat haetzem.

Ella may it lach lememar — abbaye amar: mishshum peka, rava amar: mishshum hefsed kadashim, deka mafsed leh beyadayim — dilma achel nura mimmoach dideh. mibbeod yom name, gezera mibbeod yom attu mishshechashecha.

Rav pappa amar: kol ki hay gavna — kulle alma yesh bo mishshum shevirat haetzem. may tama? leureta michaze laachila. ella, beever sheyyatza miktzato kamippalgi. man deamar kasher — ha kasher hu, uman deamar rauy laachila — hay lav bar achila hu.
Kidtanya, rabbi yishmael beno shel rabbi yochanan ben beroka omer: ever sheyyatza miktzato ushevaro — en bo mishshum shevirat haetzem.

Rav sheshet bereh derav idi amar: kol ki hay gavvna dechulle alma en bo mishshum shevirat haetzem, dehay ever ha pasul hu. ella, shevirat haetzem bena ikka benayyhu. man deamar kasher — ha kasher hu, uman deamar rauy laachila — hasheta eno rauy laachila.

Rav nachman bar yitzchak amar: kol ki hay gavvna yesh bo mishshum shevirat haetzem, may tama deha chaze laachila, dematve leh veachel leh. ella, shevirat haalya ikka benayyhu. leman deamar kasher — ha kasher hu, leman deamar rauy laachila — hay eno rauy laachila, dealya legavoah salka.

Rav ashe amar: kol ki hay gavvna vadday en bo mishshum shevirat haetzem, deha vadday eno rauy laachila kelal. ella, ever sheen alav kazzayit basar ikka benayyhu. leman deamar kasher — ha kasher hu, leman deamar rauy laachila — baenan shiur achila, velekka.

Ravina amar: kol ki hay gavvna let beh mishshum shevirat haetzem, devaenan shiur achila. ella, ever sheen alav kezayit basar bemakom ze veyesh alav kezayit basar bimkom acher ikka benayyhu. leman deamar kasher — ha kasher hu. leman deamar rauy laachila — baenan shiur achila bimkom shevira, veha lekka.
Tanya kearbea minnayyhu. detanya, rabbi omer: "bevayit echad yeachel ... veetzem lo tishberu bo", al hakkasher hu chayyayv, veeno chayyayv al happasul.
Hayta lo sheat hakkosher venifsal bishat achila — en bo mishshum shevirat etzem.
Yesh bo shiur achila — yesh bo mishshum shevirat etzem, en bo shiur achila — en bo mishshum shevirat etzem.
Harauy lammizbeach — en bo mishshum shevirat haetzem.
Bishat achila — yesh bo mishshum shevirat etzem, shello bishat achila — en bo mishshum shevirat etzem.

Ittemar: ever sheen alav kezayit basar bimkom ze veyesh alav kezayit basar bimkom acher, rabbi yochanan amar: yesh bo mishshum shevirat haetzem, rabbi shimon ben lakish amar: en bo mishshum shevirat etzem.

Etiveh rabbi yochanan lerabbi shimon ben lakish: "veetzem lo tishberu bo" — echad etzem sheyyesh alav kezayit basar, veechad etzem sheen alav kezayit basar. may en alav kezayit basar? illema deen alav kezayit basar kelal — ammay yesh bo mishshum shevirat haetzem?! ella lav, hachi kaamar: echad etzem sheyyesh alav kezayit basar bemakom ze, veechad sheen alav kezayit basar bemakom ze veyesh alav kezayit basar bemakom acher (— kashya lerabbi shimon ben lakish)!
Amar leh:

a: La, hachi kaamar: echad etzem sheyyesh alav kezayit basar mibbachutz, veechad etzem sheen alav kazzayit basar mibbachutz, veyesh alav kazzayit basar mibbifnim bimkom shevira.
Vehatanya: "veetzem lo tishberu bo" — echad etzem sheyyesh bo moach, veechad etzem sheen bo moach. uma ani mekayyem "veachlu et habbasar ballayla hazze" — bevasar sheal gabbe haetzem.

O eno ella bevasar shebbetoch haetzem, uma ani mekayyem "veetzem lo tishberu vo" — beetzem sheen bo moach, aval beetzem sheyyesh bo moach — shover veochel. veal titma, shehare yavo ase veyidche lo taase.

Keshehu omer "veetzem lo yishberu vo" befesach sheni, sheen talmud lomar, shehare kevar neemar "kechol chukkat happesach yaasu oto" — heve omer echad etzem sheyyesh bo moach veechad etzem sheen bo moach.
Metivi: ever sheyyatza miktzato, chotech ad makom shemmaggia laetzem vekolef ad shemmaggia lapperek, vechotech.
Vei amrat ever sheen alav kezayit basar bemakom ze veyesh bemakom acher en bo mishshum shevirat haetzem, lema li dekolef ad shemmaggia lapperek vechotech? niklof beh pureta venitbereh!
Abbaye amar: mishshum peka. ravina amar: bekulit.
Tenan hatam: happiggul vehannotar (vehattame) metammein et hayyadayim. rav huna verav chisda. chad amar: mippene chashede chehunna. vechad amar: mippene atzele chehunna.
Mar matne appiggul, umar matne annotar. man dematne appiggul — mishshum chashede chehunna. uman dematne annotar — mishshum atzele chehunna.
Mar matne kezayit, umar matne kevetza. man dematne kezayit — keissuro. uman dematne kevetza — ketumeato.

Ibbaya lehu: yotze gezaru rabbanan tumea o la? mi amrinan: notar digzaru tumea deate leiatzole beh, aval yotze, appoke beyadayim la mappeki leh beyadayim, la gezaru beh rabbanan tumea, o dilma la shena.
Ta shema: ever sheyyatza miktzato chotech ad shemmaggia laetzem, vekolef ad shemmaggia lapperek, vechotech. vei amrat gezaru beh rabbanan tumea, ki chatech leh may have? ha kamtamme leh!
Tumeat setarim hi, vetumeat setarim la metammeya.

Uleravina deamar: chibbure ochalin — lav chibbur hu, ucheman demipparti dame, may ikka lememar? ha kanaga bahadade veka metamme! ella: leman dematne kezayit — delet beh kezayit. uman dematne kevetza — delet beh kevetza.

Ta shema: hammotzi besar pesach mechavura lachavura, af al pi shehu belo taase, tahor. may lav — tahor veasur, deyotze mechavura lachavura kayyotze chutz limchitzato dame, umippesil, vaafillu hachi katane tahor, alma la gezaru rabbanan tumea!
La — tahor umuttar, deyotze mechavura lachavura lav kayyotze chutz limchitzato dame, vela mippesil.
Veha ka tane sefa: haochlo hare ze belo taase! bishlama leman deamar kevetza — deit beh kezayit velet beh kevetza, ella leman deamar kezayit, may ikka lememar?
Ella: beyotze bappesach la mibbaya lan dela gezaru rabbanan tumea, may tama — bene chavura zerizin hen, umizhar zehiri beh. ella, ki kamibbaya lan beyotze bekadashim, may, teku.
Umotzi besar pesach
b: Mechavura lachavura minnayin? detanya: "lo totzi min habbayit min habbasar chutza", en li ella mibbayit levayit, mechavura lachavura minnayin? talmud lomar: "chutza" — chutz laachilato.

Amar rabbi amme: hammotzi besar pesach mechavura lachavura, eno chayyayv ad sheyyanniach. hotzaa ketiv beh keshabbat: ma shabbat — ad deaved akira vehannacha, af hacha name — ad deaved akira vehannacha.
Metiv rabbi abba bar memel: hayu sovlim otan bemotot, harishonim yatzu chutz lechomat haazara vehaacharonim lo yatzu, harishonim metammein begadim vehaacharonim en metammein begadim. veha la nach?
Hu motev la vehu mefarek la, benigrarin.
Mishna ever sheyyatza miktzato, chotech ad shemmaggia laetzem, vekolef ad shemmaggia lapperek, vechotech. uvammukedashin — kotzetz bekofitz, sheen bo mishshum shevirat haetzem.
Min haagaf velifnim — kelifnim, min haagaf ulechutz — kelachutz. hachallonot veovi hachoma — kelifnim.
Gemara amar rav yehuda amar rav: vechen litfilla. ufeliga derabbi yehoshua ben levi. deamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: afillu mechitza shel barzel enah mafseket ben yisrael laavihem shebbashshamayim.
Ha gufa kashya, amrat: min haagaf velifnim — kelifnim, ha agaf atzmo — kelachutz. ema sefa: min haagaf ulechutz — kelachutz. ha agaf atzmo — kelifnim!
La kashya: kan — beshaare azara, kan — beshaare yerushalayim.
Deamar rabbi shemuel bar rav yitzchak: mippene ma lo nitkaddeshu shaare yerushalayim? mippene shemmetzorain meginnin tachtehen, bachamma mippene hachamma, uvaggeshamim mippene haggeshamim.
Veamar rabbi shemuel bar rav yitzchak: mippene ma lo nitkaddesha shaar nikkanor? mippene shemmetzorain omdin sham umachnisin behonot yadam.
Hachallonot vaovi hachoma vechulei. amar rav: gaggin vaaliyyot lo nitkaddeshu. ini?! vehaamar rav mishshum rabbi chiyyay "kezeta pischa, vehallela paka iggara".

a: May lav, deachli beiggara veamri beiggara! la: deachli beara veamri beiggara.
Ini? vehatnan: en maftirin achar happesach afikoman, veamar rav: shello yeakru mechavura lachavura. la kashya: kan — bishat achila, kan — shello bishat achila.

Ta shema, abba shaul omer: aliyyayt bet kodshe hakkodashim chamura mibbet kodshe hakkodashim. shebbet kodshe hakkodashim — kohen gadol nichnas lo paam achat bashshana, vaaliyyayt bet kodshe hakkodashim — en nichnasin lah ella paam achat beshavua, veamri la: paamayim beshavua, veamri la: paam achat beyovel, leda ma hi tzericha.

Amar rav yosef: mehechol nekum venittev inish? shane hechol, dichtiv: "vayyitten david lishlomo veno et tavnit haulam veet battav veet ganzakkav vaaliyyotav vachadarav happenimim uvet hakkapporet", uchetiv: "hakkol bichtav miyyad Adonai alay hiskil".
Ta shema: halleshachot habbenuyot bakkodesh ufetuchot lachol — tochan chol, vegaggotehen kodesh! targema rav chisda: besheggaggotehen shavin lekarka azara.

I hachi, ema sefa: benuyot bachol ufetuchot lakkodesh — tochen kodesh vegaggotehen chol. vei salka datach besheggaggotehen shavin lekarka azara, havya la mechillot, veamar rabbi yochanan: mechillot lo nitkaddeshu! ki kaamar rabbi yochanan — biftuchot lehar habbayit. ki tanya hahi — biftuchot laazara.
Vehatanya, rabbi yehuda omer: mechillot mittachat hahechol chol! ki tanya hahi — sheppetuchot lachol.
Ta shema: vegaggo kodesh!
Vetisbera?! veha katane: gaggin hallalu en ochlin sham kodshe kadashim, veen shochatin sham kadashim kallim! veella kashya gaggo kodesh! amar rav chama bar gureya: leotan shete ammot.

Ditnan: shete ammot haya beshushan habbira, achat al keren mizrachit tzefonit veachat al keren mizrachit deromit. zo sheal keren mizrachit tzefonit hayta yetera al shel moshe chatzi etzba, vezo sheal keren mizrachit deromit hayta yetera aleha chatzi etzba, nimtzet yetera al shel moshe etzba.
Velama hayu achat gedola veachat ketanna? sheyyihyu haummanin notlin bakketanna umachzirin baggedola, kede shello yavou lide meila. vetarte lema li? achat — lechaspa vedahava, veachat — levinyana.
Tenan: hachallonot veovi hachoma — kelifnim. bishlama hachallonot, mashkachat la deshavya lekarka azara. ella ovi hachoma, hechi mashkachat la?
Mashkachat la bevar shura, dichtiv: "vayyaavel chel vechoma", veamar rabbi acha veittema rabbi chanina: shura uvar shura.

Mishna shete chavurot shehayu ochlin bevayit echad, ellu hofchin et penehem helach veochlin, veellu hofchin et penehem helach veochlin, vehammecham baemtza. keshehashshammash omed limzog, kofetz et piv umachazir et panav, ad shemmaggia etzel chavurato veochel. vehakkalla hofechet et paneha veochelet.

Gemara matnitin manni? rabbi yehuda hi. detanya: "al habbattim asher yochlu oto bahem", melammed shehappesach neechol bishte chavurot. yachol yehe haochel ochel bishte mekomot — talmud lomar: "bevayit echad yeachel".
Mikkan amru: hashshammash sheachal kezayit betzad hattannur, i pikkeach hu memalle kereso mimmennu, veim ratzu bene chavura laasot immo tova — bain veyoshvin betziddo, divre rabbi yehuda.
Rabbi shimon omer: "al habbattim asher yochlu oto bahem", melammed shehaochel ochel bishte mekomot.
b: Yachol yehe neechol bishte chavurot, talmud lomar: "bevayit echad yeachel".
Bemay kamippalgi? rabbi yehuda savar: yesh em lammasoret. verabbi shimon savar: yesh em lammikra.
Hayu yoshvin venifresa mechitza benehem, ledivre haomer pesach neechol bishte chavurot — ochlin, ledivre haomer en happesach neechol bishte chavurot — en ochlin.
Hayu yoshvin venistalleka mechitza benehen, ledivre haomer haochel ochel bishne mekomot — ochlin, ledivre haomer en haochel ochel bishne mekomot — en ochlin.
Yatev rav kahana ka pashet leh mifshat. amar leh rav ashe lerav kahana: vetibbee lach ibbaya: silluk mechitza vaasiyyayt mechitza mi have kishne mekomot, vechishte chavurot dame, o la? teku.
Hakkalla hofechet et paneha vechulei. may tama? amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: mippene shehi bosha.

Rav huna bereh derav natan ikkela leve rav nachman bar yitzchak. amaru leh: ma shemach? amar lehu: rav huna. amaru: nittev mar appureya! yetev, yehavu leh kasa, kabbeleh bechad zimna veshatyeh bitre zimne, vela ahdar appeh.
Amaru leh: may tama karet lecha rav huna? amar lehu baal hashshem ani. may tama ki amaru lach nittev appureya yetevt? amar lehu: kol ma sheyyomar lecha baal habbayit ase (chutz mitztze).

May tama ki yahavi lach kasa kabbelt bechad zimna? amar lehu: mesarvin lakkatan, veen mesarvin laggadol. may tama ishteteh bitre zimne? amar lehu: detanya, hashshote koso bevat achat hare ze gargeran, shenayim — derech eretz, shelosha — miggasse haruach. may tama la ahdart appach? amar lehu: "kalla hofechet paneha" tenan.

Rabbi yishmael berabbi yose ikkela leve rabbi shimon berabbi yose ben lakonya. yehavu leh kasa, kabbeleh bechad zimna veshatyeh bechad zimna. amri leh: la savar la mar hashshote koso bevat achat hare ze gargeran? amar lehu: la amri bechoscha katan veyencha matok ucheresi rechava.
Amar rav huna: bene chavura nichnasin bishlosha, veyotzin afillu beechad. amar rabba: vehu deayel beiddana dirgili lemeal, vehu dirgash behu dayyayla.
Amar ravina: venotnin sechar damim, vetzarich haacharon lehosif damim. velet hilcheta kevoteh.
Haderan alach ketzad tzolin

a: Mishna haishsha bizman shehi bevet balah, shachat aleha balah veshachat aleha aviha — tochal mishshel balah. halcha regel rishon laasot bevet aviha, shachat aleha aviha veshachat aleha balah — tochal bimkom shehi rotza.
Yatom sheshshachatu alav appotroppesin — yochal bimkom shehu rotze. eved shel shene shuttafin lo yochal mishshel shenehen. mi shechetzyo eved vechetzyo ben chorin lo yochal mishshel rabbo.
Gemara shamat minna yesh berera? may rotza — bishat shechita.
Ureminhu: ishsha, regel harishon ochelet mishshel aviha. mikkan veelach, rotza — ochelet mishshel aviha, rotza — mishshel balah.
La kashya: kan, birdufa lelech. kan, besheenah redufa.

Dichtiv: "az hayiti veenav kemotzet shalom", veamar rabbi yochanan: kechalla shennimtzet shelema bevet chamiha, uredufa lelech lehaggid shivchah bevet aviha. kedichtiv: "vehaya bayyom hahu neum Adonai tikrei ishi velo tikrei li od bali", amar rabbi yochanan: kechalla bevet chamiha, velo kechalla bevet aviha.
"Achot lanu ketanna veshadayim en lah", amar rabbi yochanan: zo elam, shezzachta lilmod, velo zachta lelammed.

"Ani choma veshaday kammigdalot", amar rabbi yochanan: "ani choma" — zo tora, "veshaday kammigdalot" — ellu talmide chachamim. verava amar: "ani choma" — zo keneset yisrael, "veshaday kammigdalot" — ellu batte chenesiyyot uvatte midrashot.
Amar rav zutera bar toviyya amar rav, may dichtiv: "asher banenu kintiim meguddalim binurehem benotenu chezaviyyot mechuttavot tavnit hechol",

"Asher banenu kintiim" — ellu bachure yisrael shello taamu taam chet. "benotenu chezaviyyot" — ellu betulot yisrael sheogdot pitchehen levaalehen. vechen hu omer: "umalu kammizrak kezaviyyot mizbeach", ibbaet ema mehacha: "mezavenu meleim mefikim mizzan el zan",
"Mechuttavot tavnit hechol" — ellu vaellu maale alehen hakkatuv keillu nivna hechol bimehen.

"Devar Adonai asher haya el hoshea vegomer bime uzziyyahu yotam achaz yechizkiyya melech yehuda". beferek echad nitnabbeu arbaa neviim, vegadol shebbechullan hoshea, shenneemar: "techillat dibber Adonai behoshea". vechi behoshea dibber techilla? vahalo mimmoshe ad hoshea kamma neviim! amar rabbi yochanan: techilla learbaa neviim shennitnabbeu beoto happerek, veellu hen: hoshea, yeshaya, amos umicha.

Amar lo hakkadosh baruch hu lehoshea: banecha chatu. vehaya lo lomar: banecha hem, bene chanunecha hem, bene avraham yitzchak veyaakov, galgel rachamecha alehen. lo dayyo shello amar kach, ella amar lefanav: ribbono shel olam, kol haolam shellecha hu, haavirem beumma acheret.

Amar hakkadosh baruch hu: ma eese lezaken ze? omar lo: lech vekach ishsha zona veholed lecha banim zenunim, veachar kach omar lo shallechah meal panecha. im hu yachol lishloach — af ani ashallach et yisrael. shenneemar: "vayyomer Adonai el hoshea lech kach lecha eshet zenunim veyalde zenunim", uchetiv: "vayyelech vayyikkach et gomer bat divlayim", "gomer", amar rav: shehakkol gomrim bah. "bat
b: Divlayim", dibba raa bat dibba raa. ushemuel amar: shemmetuka befi hakkol kidvela. verabbi yochanan amar: shehakkol dashin bah kidvela.
Davar acher: "gomer", amar rabbi yehuda: shebbikkeshu legammer mamonan shel yisrael beyameha, rabbi yochanan amar: bazzu vegamru, shenneemar: "ki ibbedam melech aram vaysimem keafar ladush".

"Vattahar vatteled lo ben vayyomer Adonai elav kera shemo yizreel ki od meat ufakadti et deme yizreel al bet yehu vehishbatti mamlechut bet yisrael vattahar od vatteled bat vayyomer lo kera shemah lo ruchama ki lo osif od arachem et bet yisrael ki naso essa lahem vattahar vatteled ben vayyomer (Adonai elav) kera shemo lo ammi ki attem lo ammi veanochi lo ehye lachem",

Leachar shennoldu [lo] shene vanim uvat achat, amar lo hakkadosh baruch hu lehoshea: lo haya lecha lilmod mimmoshe rabbach? shekkevan sheddibbarti immo perash min haishsha, af atta bedol atzmecha mimmenna. amar lo: ribbono shel olam yesh li banim mimmenna veen ani yachol lehotziah velo legarshah.

Amar leh hakkadosh baruch hu: uma atta sheishtecha zona uvanecha [bene] zenunim, veen atta yodea im shellecha hen im shel acherim hen — kach, yisrael shehen banay, bene bechunay bene avraham yitzchak veyaakov, echad mearbaa kinyanin shekkaniti beolami.

Tora kinyan echad, dichtiv: "Adonai kanani reshit darko". shamayim vaaretz kinyan echad, dichtiv: "kone shamayim vaaretz". bet hammikdash kinyan echad, dichtiv: "har ze kanta yemino". yisrael kinyan echad dichtiv: "am zu kanita" — veatta amarta haavirem beumma acheret!

Kevan sheyyada shechata, amad levakkesh rachamim al atzmo. amar lo hakkadosh baruch hu: ad sheatta mevakkesh rachamim al atzmecha — bakkesh rachamim al yisrael, sheggazarti alehem shalosh gezerot baavurecha.

Amad uvikkesh rachamim uvittel gezera, vehitchil levarchan, shenneemar: "vehaya mispar bene yisrael kechol hayyam vegomer vehaya bimkom asher yeamer lahem lo ammi attem yeamer lahem bene el chay venikbetzu bene yehuda uvene yisrael yachdav vegomer uzeratiha li baaretz verichamti et lo ruchama veamarti lelo ammi ammi atta".

Amar rabbi yochanan: oy lah larabbanut shemmekabberet et bealeha. sheen lach kol navi venavi shello kippeach arbaa melachim beyamav, shenneemar: "chazon yeshayahu ven amotz asher chaza al yehuda virushalayim vegomer".
Amar rabbi yochanan: mippene ma zacha yarovam ben yoash melech yisrael lehimmanot im malche yehuda? mippene shello kibbel lashon hara al amos.
Menalan deimmeni? dichtiv: "devar Adonai asher haya el hoshea ben beeri bime uzziyya yotam achaz yechizkiyya malche yehuda uvime yarovam ben yoash melech yisrael".

Umenalan delo kibbel lashon hara? dichtiv: "vayyishlach amatzya kohen bet el el yarovam melech yisrael lemor kashar alecha vegomer", uchetiv: "ki cho amar amos bacherev yamut yarovam vegomer". amar: chas veshalom amar oto tzaddik kach, veim amar — ma eese lo? shechina amra lo.

Amar rabbi elazar: afillu bishat kaso shel hakkadosh baruch hu zocher et harachamim. shenneemar: "ki lo osif od arachem et bet yisrael". rabbi yose bar rabbi chanina amar mehacha: "ki naso essa lahem".
Veamar rabbi elazar: lo higla hakkadosh baruch hu et yisrael leven haummot ella kede sheyyittosfu alehem gerim, shenneemar: "uzeratiha li baaretz". kelum adam zorea sea ella lehachenis kamma korin.
Verabbi yochanan amar mehacha: "verichamti et lo ruchama".

Amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yochay, may dichtiv: "al talshen eved el adonav pen yekallelcha veashamta", uchetiv: "dor aviv yekallel veet immo lo yevarech", mishshum deaviv yekallel veet immo lo yevarech — al talshen?
Ella, afillu dor sheaviv yekallel veet immo lo yevarech — al talshen eved el adonav. menalan — mehoshea.

Amar rabbi oshaya, may dichtiv: "tzidkat pirzono beyisrael", tzedaka asa hakkadosh baruch hu beyisrael sheppizzeran leven haummot. vehayeynu daamar leh hahu mina lerabbi chanina: anan meallinan minnayychu, ketiv bechu: "ki sheshet chodashim yashav sham vegomer", veillu anan itinchu gabban kamma shene vela ka avdinan lechu midde. amar lo: retzoncha yittafel lach talmid echad.

Nitpal leh rabbi oshaya, amar leh: mishshum dela yaditu hechi tabedu, techallinan kullehu — letanhu gabbayychu. may deikka gabbayychu, kare lechu malchuta ketiata. amar leh: gappa deromae! beha nachatinan uveha salkinan.

Tane rabbi chiyyay, may dichtiv: "elohim hevin darkah vehu yada et mekomah", yodea hakkadosh baruch hu et yisrael sheenan yecholin lekabbel gezerot shel romiyyim, lefichach higla otam levavel. veamar rabbi elazar: lo higla hakkadosh baruch hu et yisrael levavel ella mippene sheamukka kishol, shenneemar: "miyyad sheol efdem mimmavet egalem". rabbi chanina amar: mippene shekkarov leshonam lilshon tora.
Rabbi yochanan amar: mippene sheshshiggeran levet imman. mashal leadam shekkaas al ishto, lehechan meshaggerah — levet immah.

Vehayeynu derabbi alekkesanderi, deamar: shelosha chazru lemattaatan, ellu hen: yisrael, kesef mitzrayim, uchetav luchot. yisrael — ha daamaran. kesef mitzrayim, dichtiv: "vayhi bashshana hachamishit lammelech rechavam ala shishak melech mitzrayim al yerushalayim vegomer". ketav halluchot, dichtiv: "vaashabberem leenechem", tana: luchot nishberu veotiyyot porchot.
Ulla amar: kede sheyyochlu

a: Temarim veyaasku battora. ulla ikkela lefumebdita, karivu leh tiryana detamre. amar lehu: kamma ki hane bezuza? amaru leh: telat bezuza. amar: mela tzanna deduvesha bezuza, uvavlae la aski beorayyta.
Belelya tzaaruhu. amar: mela tzanna samma demota bezuza bevavel, uvavlae aski beorayyta.
Veamar rabbi elazar, may dichtiv: "vehalchu ammim rabbim veamru lechu venaale el har Adonai el bet elohe yaakov vegomer". elohe yaakov, velo elohe avraham veyitzchak?

Ella, lo keavraham shekkatuv bo "har", shenneemar: "asher yeamer hayyom behar Adonai yerae", velo keyitzchak shekkatuv bo "sade", shenneemar: "vayyetze yitzchak lasuach bassade", ella keyaakov shekkerao "bayit", shenneemar: "vayyikra et shem hammakom hahu bet el".

Amar rabbi yochanan: gadol kibbutz galiyyot kayyom shennivreu bo shamayim vaaretz, shenneemar: "venikbetzu bene yehuda uvene yisrael yachdav vesamu lahem rosh echad vealu min haaretz ki gadol yom yizreel", uchetiv: "vayhi erev vayhi voker yom echad".
Yatom sheshshachatu alav appotroppesin vechulei. shamat minna yesh berera. amar rabbi zera: "se labbayit" — mikkol makom.

Tanu rabbanan: "se labbayit" — melammed sheadam mevi veshochet al yede beno uvitto hakketannim veal yede avdo veshifchato hakkenaanim, ben middatan ben shello middatan. aval eno shochet al yede beno uvitto haggedolim veal yede avdo veshifchato haivrim veal yad ishto, ella middatan.

Tanya iddach: lo yishchot adam lo al yede beno uvitto haggedolim veal yede avdo veshifchato haivrim veal yad ishto, ella middatan. aval shochet hu al yede beno uvitto hakketannim veal yede avdo veshifchato hakkenaanim, ben middatan uven shello middatan, vechullan sheshshachatu veshachat rabban alehen — yotzin beshel rabban, veen yotzin beshel atzman,
Chutz min haishsha sheyyechola lemachot.
May shena ishsha? amar rava: ishsha vechol dedame la.
Ha gufa kashya, amrat: chutz min haishsha — sheyyechola lemachot. tama demachay, ha la machay — nafka beshel balah, veha katane resha: "velo al yede ishto ella middatan", ha setama la nafka!
May "ella middatan" — lav deamri in, ella bistama, leappoke hecha daamur la.
Veha "kullam sheshshachatu veshachat rabban alehen — yotzin beshel rabban" devistama, vekatane: chutz min haishsha — mippene sheyyechola lemachot!
Amar rava: kevan sheshshachatu en lecha michuy gadol mizze.
Eved shel shene shuttafin vechulei. rame leh rav ena sava lerav nachman: tenan, eved shel shene shuttafin lo yochal mishshel shenehen. vehatanya: ratza — mizze ochel, ratza — mizze ochel!
Amar leh: ena sava, veamri la: patya ukkama, minni uminnach tistayyem shemateta. matnitin — bidkafdi ahadade, barayyta — dela kafdi ahadade.
Mi shechetzyo eved vechetzyo ben chorin lo yochal mishshel rabbo vechulei. mishshel rabbo hu delo yochal, aval mishshel atzmo — yochal. veha tanya: lo yochal lo mishshello velo mishshel rabbo.
La kashya: kan — kemishna rishona, kan — kemishna acharona. ditnan: mi shechetzyo eved vechetzyo ben chorin — oved et rabbo yom echad veet atzmo yom echad, divre bet hillel. bet shammay omrim:
b: Tikkantem et rabbo, veet atzmo lo tikkantem. lissa shifcha eno yachol — shekkevar chetzyo ben chorin, lissa bat chorin eno yachol — sheadayin chetzyo eved. yivtal, vahalo lo nivra haolam ella lifriyya ureviyya, shenneemar: "lo tohu veraah (ella) lashevet yetzarah". ella, mippene tikkun haolam kofin et rabbo veose oto ben chorin, vechotev shetar al chatzi damav.
Vechazru bet hillel lehorot kevet shammay.
Mishna haomer leavdo tze ushechot alay et happesach, shachat gedi — yochal, shachat tale — yochal, shachat gedi vetale — yochal min harishon.
Shachach ma amar lo rabbo, ketzad yaase? yishchat tale ugedi, veyomar: im gedi amar li rabbi — gedi shello vetale shelli, veim tale amar li rabbi — hattale shello ugedi shelli.
Shachach rabbo ma amar lo, shenehen yetzu levet hasserefa, ufeturin millaasot pesach sheni.
Gemara peshita! shachat gedi — yochal, af al gav dirgil betale. shachat tale — yochal, af al gav dirgil bigdi.
Shachat gedi vetale — yochal min harishon. veha tanya: en nimnin al shene fesachim keechad!
Matnitin bemelech umalka.

Vehatanya: en nimnin al shene fesachim keechad, umaase bemelech umalka sheamru leavdehem: tzeu veshachatu alenu et happesach, veyatzu veshachatu alehen shene fesachim. bau veshaalu et hammelech, amar lahem: lechu veshaalu et hammalka. bau veshaalu min hammalka, amra lahem: lechu veshaalu et rabban gamliel.
Bau veshaalu et rabban gamliel, amar lahem: malka umelech dedatan kalla alehen — yochlu min harishon. anan lo nochal lo min harishon velo min hashsheni.

Veshuv paam achat nimtzet haletaa bevet hammitbachayim uvikkeshu letamme kol hasseuda kullah. bau veshaalu et hammelech, amar lahem: lechu veshaalu et hammalka. bau veshaalu et hammalka, amra lahem: lechu veshaalu et rabban gamliel.

Bau veshaalu oto, amar lahem: bet hammitbachayim roteach o tzonen? amru lo: roteach. amar lahem: lechu vehatilu aleha kos shel tzonen. halchu vehetilu aleha kos shel tzonen verichasha, vetiher rabban gamliel kol hasseuda kullah.
Nimtza melech taluy bammalka, venimtzeta malka teluya berabban gamliel, nimtzet kol hasseuda teluya berabban gamliel.
Shachach ma sheamar lo rabbo vechulei. shelli?! ma shekkana eved kana rabbo!
Amar abbaye: holech etzel roe haragil rabbo etzlo, denicha leh betakkanta derabbeh, umakne leh chad minnayyhu al menat sheen lerabbo reshut bo.

Shachach rabbo ma sheamar lo vechulei. amar abbaye: lo shanu ella sheshshachach achar zerika, dividdana deizzerik dam — hava chaze laachila. aval shachach lifne zerika, dechi izzerik dam la hava chaze laachila — chayyayvin laasot pesach sheni.
Ikka dematne la abbarayyta: chamishsha shennitarvu orot pischehen ze baze, venimtzet yabbelet beechad mehen — kullan yotzin levet hasserefa, ufeturin millaasot pesach sheni.
Amar abbaye: lo shanu ella shennitarvu leachar zerika, dividdana deizzerik dam miha hava chaze laachila. aval nitarvu lifne zerika — chayyayvin laasot pesach sheni.
Man dematne ammatnitin, kol shekken abbarayyta. man dematne abbarayyta, aval ammatnitin la. kevan dichsherin ninhu, dei iddechar have chaze laachila, kamme shemayya galya.
Amar mar: ufeturin millaasot pesach sheni. veha ikka chad dela nafek!
Mishshum dela ifshar. hechi lebed? layte kol chad vechad pesach — ka mayyte chullin laazara, dearbea minnayyhu avdi lehu.
Layte kullehu chad pesach — nimtza pesach neechol shello limnuyav.
Hay may? nayte kol chad minnayyhu pischo, venaytne venema: i didi baal mum — hay deayytay hasheta nihve pesach, vei didi tam — hay deayytay hasheta nihve shelamim!
La efshar,

a: Mishshum deikka chaze vashok, dechohanim hu deachli leh.
Venayte kol chad vechad kohen bahadeh.
Hay kohen hechi dame? i deaved pesach — dilma hay pesach hu, venimtza pesach neechol shello limnuyav. vei dela aved pesach — dilma shelamim hu, vela aved pesach!
Venayte kol chamsha chad kohen dela avad pesach, venimmene illaveh hane chamishsha pesachim, demimma nafshach ikka chad dela aved pesach, veka nafki beh.
Ella mishshum deka memaet baachilat shelamim, deillu pesach leyom velayla, veillu shelamim lishne yamim velayla echad.
Venayte motar happesach.
Venema: i didi baal mum — hay deayytay hasheta nihve pesach, i didi tam hu — nihve hay deayytay hasheta shelamim, demotar happesach neechol leyom velayla echad.
Vechi mafrishin techilla lammotarot?! venitrechu venayyte motar happesach!
Ella mishshum semicha. deillu pesach la bae semicha, veillu motar bae semicha.
Ha tinach korban anashim. korban nashim, may ikka lememar?
Ella mishshum mattanot. deillu pesach — mattana achat, veillu shelamim — shetayim shehen arba.
May nafka minna? veha tenan: kol hannittanin al mizbeach hachitzon shennetanan bemattan achat — kipper,
Ella mishshum deillu pesach bishficha, veillu shelamim bizrika.
May nafka minna? veha tanya: kol hannittanin bizrika shennetanan bishficha yatza. emar deka amrinan dei avad, lechattechilla name?!
Mishna haomer levanav: hareni shochet et happesach al mi sheyyaale mikkem rishon lirushalayim, kevan shehichnis harishon rosho verubbo — zacha bechelko umezakke et echav immo.
Gemara shema minna yesh berera!
Amar rabbi yochanan, kede lezarzan bemitzvot kaamar.

Dayka name dekatane: umezakke echav immo, i amrat bishlama deamninhu meikkara — shappir, ella i amrat dela amninhu meikkara, levatar deshachet mi ka mitmannu? veha tenan: nimnin umoshchin yedehen mimmennu ad sheyyishshachet. shema minna.
Tanya name hachi: maase vekadmu banot levanim, venimtza banot zerizot uvanim shefalim.
Mishna leolam nimnin alav ad sheyyihye bo kezayit lechol echad veechad. nimnin umoshchin et yedehen mimmennu ad sheyyishshachet. rabbi shimon omer: ad sheyyizzarek et haddam.
Gemara may ka mashma lan? ha ka mashma lan deaf al gav deimmeni alav chavura zo, chozeret venimnin alav chavura acheret.
Nimnin umoshchin et yedehen ad sheyyishshachet vechulei. amar abbaye: machaloket limmashech,
Derabbanan savri: "mihyot misse" — mechayyuteh dese. verabbi shimon savar: mehavayayteh dese. aval limmanot — divre hakkol ad sheyyishshachet, deamar kera: "bemichsat nefashot", vahadar: "tachossu".
Tanya name hachi: nimnin umoshchin et yedehen mimmennu ad sheyyishshachet, rabbi shimon omer: nimnin ad sheyyishshachet, umoshchin ad sheyyizzarek haddam.
b: Mishna hamemanne immo acher bechelko — rashshain bene chavura litten lo et shello, vehu ochel mishshello, vehen ochlin mishshellahen.

Gemara ibbaya lehu: bene chavura shehayu yadav shel echad mehen yafot, mahu sheyyomru lo: tol chelkecha vatze. mi amrinan, matze amar lehu: ha kabbeltun. o dilma, matzu lememar leh: ki kabbelynan — letaykkone zevicha, addata deachlat tefe minnan — la kabbelynach.

Ta shema: hamemanne acherim immo al chelko — rashshain [bene chavura] litten lo et shello, vehu ochel et shello, vehen ochlin et shellahen. may tama? lav mishshum dehave leh keyadayim shel echad mehen yafot. vei salka datach yadav yafot matze amar lehu kabbeltun, nihve hay keyadav yafot!
Amri: la, deot shane, dei name tarvayyhu kechad mibbene chavura hu deachli, matze amri leh: dela nicha lan inash nuchera gabban.

Ta shema: hashshammash sheachal kezayit basar betzad hattannur, im haya pikkeach — memalle kereso mimmennu. im ratzu bene chavura laasot tova immo — bain veyoshvin betziddo veochlin, divre rabbi yehuda. ratzu — in, lo ratzu — la. veammay? nema lehu: ha kabbeltun.
Shane hatam, deamri leh: ki kabbelynach — addata denatrechach kamman. lemitrach lan ledidach — la kabbelynach.

Ta shema: bene chavura shehaya yadav shel echad mehen yafot, rashshain lomar: tol chelkecha vatze. velo od, ella afillu chamishsha veasu sibbolet, rashshain lomar lo: tol chelkecha vatze. shema minna.
May "velo od"? la mibbaya kaamar. la mibbaya pesach, dematze amri leh: ki kabbelynach letakkone zevicha, ella afillu sibbolet name, detzavvta bealma hu, rashshain lomar lo: tol chelkecha vatze.
Ikka deamri: ha la ibbaya lan, ella hachi hu deibbaya lan: bene chavura rashshain lechallek, o enan rashshain lechallek?
Ta shema: bene chavura shehayu yadav shel echad mehen yafot — rashshain lomar lo: tol chelkecha vatze. yadav yafot — in, en yadav yafot — la. shema minna.
Rav pappa verav huna bereh derav yehoshua arivu rifta bahade hadade. addeachel rav huna bereh derav yehoshua chada, achel rav pappa arba. amar leh: pelag li. amar leh: kabbeltun.
Etiveh kol hane teyuvata, veshanni kidshanninan. etiveh bene chavura. amar leh: hatam deamri leh ki kabbelynach — letaykkone zevicha. etiveh sibbolet, pelag leh.
Azal arev bahade ravina. addeachel rav huna bereh derav yehoshua chada, achel ravina temanya. amar: mea pappe vela chada ravina.
Tanu rabbanan: hamemanne acherim immo al pischo veal chagigato — maot shebbeyado chullin. vehammocher olato ushelamav — lo asa velo kelum, umaot kol shehen yippelu lindava.

Vechi meachar delo asa velo kelum, maot ammay yippelu lindava? amar rava: kenasa. umay "kol shehen" — af al gav dela havo shavu ella arbea, vihavu leh chamsha — afillu behahi yattira name kansuhu rabbanan.

Amar ulla, veittema rabbi oshaya: efshar yadi chavrin bavlae tama dehay milleta. ze hifrish tale lefischo, veze hifrish maot lefischo, heach hekdesh chal al hekdesh, dekatane: maot shebbeyado chullin?

a: Amar abbaye: i lav deokmeh rabbi oshaya lehahi bimmanne zona al pischo verabbi hi, hava mokemyna lah lehahi bekadashim kallim veallibba derabbi yose haggelili, deamar: kadashim kallim mamon bealim hu,
Aval befesach la meshayyayr inish, bemaot vadday meshayyayr inish, demeikkara ki mafresh lehu — addata dehachi mafresh lehu.
Veha rabbi hi, umishshum hachi maot shebbeyado chullin, devappesach la meshayyayr inish, uvemaot vadday meshayyayr inish.
Vehahi deka moke la rabbi oshaya kerabbi — la mokemyna leh ana kerabbi, divfesach la meshayyayr inish — uvemaot meshayyayr inish. demeikkara ki mafresh lehu — addata dehachi mafresh lehu.
Veha lekka leokome kerabbi yose, deha tane ba: vehammocher olato ushelamav — lo asa velo chelum.
Vehasheta deokmeh rabbi oshaya lehahi bimmanne zona al pischo, verabbi hi, shema minna disvira leh afillu befischo meshayyayr inish.
May hi derabbi oshaya, ditnan: natan lah mukedashin beetnannah — hare ellu muttarin.

Ofot dechullin — hare ellu asurin. shehaya baddin: uma im mukedashim shehammum posel bahen — en etnan umechir chal alehen, ofot sheen hammum posel bahen — eno din sheen etnan umechir chal alehen? talmud lomar: "lechol neder" — lerabbot et haofot.

Kal vachomer lammukedashin meatta: ma ofot sheen hammum posel bahen — etnan umechir chal alehen, mukedashin shehammum posel bahen — eno din sheetnan umechir chal alehen? talmud lomar: "lechol neder" — perat lindor.
Ella tama dichtav rachamana "neder", ha lav hachi, hava amena mukedashim chal issur etnan alehen, veha en adam oser davar sheeno shello!
Amar rabbi oshaya: bimmanne zona al pischo, verabbi hi.
May rabbi? detanya: "im yimat habbayit mihyot misse", hachayehu misse. mikkede achila, velo mikkede mikkach.
Rabbi omer: af mikkede mikkach, sheim en lo — memanne acher immo al pischo veal chagigato, umaot shebbeyado chullin, sheal menat ken hikdishu yisrael et pischehen.
Rabba verabbi zera, chad amar: beetzim litzliyyayto kulle alma la peligi, dechevan detakkanta defesach hu — kegufa defesach dame. ki peligi bematztza umaror.
Rabbanan savri: ha achila achariti hi. verabbi savar: kevan dehechshero defesach hu — kegufa defesach dame.

Vechad amar: bematztza umaror name kulle alma la peligi, dichtiv: "al matztzot umerorim yochluhu", dechevan demachshirin defesach ninhu — kefesach dame. ki peligi likkach bo chaluk, likkach bo tallit. rabbanan savri: "mihyot misse" amar rachamana, hachayehu lasse, verabbi savar: hachaye atzmecha misse.

Uleabbaye deamar: i lav deokma rabbi oshaya lehahi bimmanne zona al pischo verabbi hi, have mokminan la bekadashim kallim veallibba derabbi yose haggelili, deamar kadashim [kallim] memon bealim hu, aval befesach la meshayyayr inish —
Ha katane behedya: "sheal menat ken hikdishu yisrael et pischehen"? ema: sheal menat ken hikdishu yisrael meot pischehen.
Mishna zav sheraa shete reiyyot — shochatin alav bashshevii. raa shalosh — shochatin alav bashshemini shello.
Shomeret yom keneged yom — shochatin aleha bashsheni shellah, raata shene yamim — shochatin aleha bashshelishi.
Vehazzava — shochatin aleha bashshemini.
Gemara amar rav yehuda amar rav: shochatin vezorkin al tevul yom umechussar kippurim,
b: Veen shochatin vezorkin al teme sheretz. veulla amar: af shochatin vezorkin al teme sheretz.
Lerav, may shena tevul yom — dachaze leureta? teme sheretz name chaze leureta! mechussar tevila.
Tevul yom name — mechussar heerev shemesh! shimsha mimmela arva.
Mechussar kippurim name — ha mechussar kappara! shekkinno beyado.
Teme sheretz name — hare mikve lefanav! dilma pasha. i hachi, mechussar kippurim name dilma pasha! kegon demasrinhu levet din,
Vechidrav shemaya, deamar: chazaka en bet din shel kohanim omdin mishsham ad sheyyichlu maot shebbashshofarot.
Ulerav, middeorayyta michze chaze verabbanan hu digzaru beh, allema amar rav metammein echad mehen besheretz.
Ella, lerav middeorayyta name la chaze, dichtiv: "ish ish ki yihye tame lanefesh". mi la askinan shechal shevii shello lihyot beerev happesach, dehayynu tumeat sheretz, veamar rachamana: niddeche!
Vechi tema mimmay dehachi?

Savar la kerabbi yitzchak, deamar: temee met mitzva hayu, shechal shevii shellahen lihyot beerev happesach, shenneemar: "velo yachlu laasot happesach bayyom hahu", beyom hahu hu deenan yecholin laasot, aval lemachar yecholin laasot, veamar rachamana: niddecho.
Tenan: zav sheraa shete reiyyot — shochatin alav bashshevii. may lav — dela tavel, ushema minna: shochatin vezorkin al teme sheretz!
La, detavel. i tavel, may ka mashma lan! ha ka mashma lan, deaf al gav dimchussar heerev hashshemesh, ka mashma lan deshimsha mimmela arva.
Hachi name mistabbera, middekatane sefa: raa shalosh reiyyot — shochatin alav bashshemini. i amrat bishlama zav sheraa shete reiyyot shochatin alav bashshevii, detavel — itzterich.

Salka datach amena, raa shete reiyyot bishvii hu dela mechussar maase, aval raa shalosh bashshemini, dimchussar maase — mechussar kappara, la. ka mashma lan deaf al gav dimchussar kappara, shochatin vezorkin illaveh.
Ella i amrat raa shete reiyyot bishvii, dela tavel — raa shalosh bashshemini lema li?

Hasheta yesh lomar raa shete reiyyot bashshevii, dela tavel, detame mealleya hu — shachatinan vezarkinan illaveh. raa shalosh bashshemini, detavel leh bashshevii, diklisha tumea — lo kol shekken deshachatinan vezarkinan illaveh!
Ella lav, shema minna: raa shete reiyyot bashshevii deshachatinan illaveh, detavel.
La, leolam ema lach dela tavel, veitzterich. salka datach amena bashshevii hu divyado letakken,
Aval bashshemini deen beyado lehakeriv korban, ema pashi beh kohanim, ka mashma lan kidrav shemaya.

Vehazzava shochatin vechulei. tane tanna kammeh derav adda bar ahava: "vehazzava shochatin aleha bashshevii shellah". amar leh: zava bashshevii shellah mi chazya? afillu leman deamar shochatin vezorkin al teme sheretz, hane mille teme sheretz — dachaze leureta, ha — ad limchar dematya kappara la chazya! ema: "bashshemini".
Peshita! mahu detema kevan dimchassera kappara — la, ka mashma lan kidrav shemaya.
Ravina amar — "nidda" tena kammeh: "vehannidda shochatin aleha bashshevii".

Amar leh: nidda bashshevii mi chazya? afillu leman deamar shochatin vezorkin al teme sheretz, dachaze leureta, nidda leureta dishvii hu detavla, ad shemini deavda heerev shemesh la chazya! ella ema: "bashshemini".
Peshita! hasheta uma zava dimychassera kappara — shochatin vezorkin aleha bashshemini, nidda dela meychassera kappara — tzericha lememar deshachatinan vezarkinan ala?!
Nidda itztericha leh, ha ka mashma lan: bashshemini in, bashshevii la, kidtanya: kol chayyayve tevilot tevilatan bayyom, nidda veyoledet tevilatan ballayla.
Detanya: yachol tehe tovelet mibbeod yom? talmud lomar: "shivat yamim tihye beniddatah" — tehe beniddatah kol shiva. veyoledet ittakkash lenidda.
Mishna haonen,

a: Vehamefakkeach et haggal, vechen mi shehivtichuhu lehotzio mibbet haasurim, vehachole vehazzaken shehen yecholin leechol kezayit — shochatin alehen.
Al kullam en shochatin alehen bifne atzman, shemma yaviu et happesach lide fesul.
Lefichach im era bahen pesul — peturin millaasot pesach sheni, chutz min hamefakkeach baggal, shehu tame mittechillato.

Gemara amar rabba bar huna amar rabbi yochanan: lo shanu ella bet haasurin degoy, aval bet haasurin deyisrael — shochatin bifne atzmo, kevan deavtechinhu, mappek leh, dichtiv: "sheerit yisrael lo yaasu avla velo yedabberu chazav".
Amar rav chisda: ha deamrat bet haasurin degoyim, la amaran ella chutz lechomat bet page. aval lifnim mechomat bet page — shochatin alav bifne atzmo. may tama — efshar deamtu leh veachel leh.
Lefichach im era vechulei. amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: lo shanu ella gal agol, aval gal aroch — patur millaasot pesach sheni, ema: tahor haya bishat shechita.

Tanya name hachi: rabbi shimon beno shel rabbi yochanan ben beroka omer: mefakkeach baggal — ittim patur ittim chayyayv. ketzad? gal agol venimtzet tumea tachtav — chayyayv, gal aroch venimtzet tumea tachtav — patur, ema tahor haya bishat shechita.
Mishna en shochatin et happesach al hayyachid — divre rabbi yehuda, verabbi yose mattir. vaafillu chavura shel mea sheenan yecholin leechol kezayit — en shochatin alehen.
Veen osin chavurat nashim vaavadim uketannim.

Gemara tanu rabbanan: minnayin sheen shochatin et happesach al hayyachid, talmud lomar: "lo tuchal lizboach et happasach beachad", divre rabbi yehuda. verabbi yose omer: yachid veyachol leochlo — shochatin alav, asara veen yecholin leochlo — en shochatin alehen.
Verabbi yose, hay "beachad" may aved leh? mibbee leh lechidrabbi shimon. detanya, rabbi shimon omer: minnayin lazzoveach et pischo bevamat yachid bishat issur habbamot shehu belo taase —

Talmud lomar: "lo tuchal lizboach et happasach beachad shearecha". yachol af bishat hetter habbamot ken, talmud lomar: "beachad shearecha" — lo amru ella beshaa shekkol yisrael nichnasin beshaar echad.
Verabbi yehuda, hay mena leh? tarte shamat minna.
Ulerabbi yose, mimmay dilhachi dekaamar rabbi shimon? dilma kidkaamar rabbi yehuda hu daata? amar lach: la salka datach, deha ketiv: "ish lefi ochlo".

Rame leh rav ukeva bar chinnana mipparishna lerava: mi amar rabbi yehuda en shochatin et happesach al hayyachid? ureminhu: ishsha barishon — shochatin aleha bifne atzmah, uvashsheni osin otah tefela laacherim, divre rabbi yehuda. amar leh: la tema bifne atzmah, ella ema: bifne atzman.

Amar leh: mi avdinan chavura shekkullah nashim? vehatnan: en osin chavurat nashim vaavadim uketannim, may lav — nashim lechodayyhu, vaavadim lechodayyhu, uketannim lechodayyhu? amar leh: la, nashim vaavadim uketannim. nashim vaavadim — mishshum tiflut, ketannim vaavadim — mishshum
b: Peritzuta.

Gufa: ishsha barishon — shochatin aleha bifne atzmah, uvashsheni osin otah tefela laacherim, divre rabbi yehuda. rabbi yose omer: ishsha bashsheni — shochatin aleha bifne atzmah, veen tzarich lomar barishon. rabbi shimon omer: ishsha barishon — osin otah tefela laacherim, bashsheni en shochatin aleha kol ikkar.
Bemay kamippalgi? rabbi yehuda savar: "bemichsat nefashot", vaafillu nashim. vechi tema, i hachi afillu bashsheni name? ketiv: "cheto yissa haish hahu". ish — in, ishsha — la.
Vechi tema, i hachi afillu tefila name bashsheni la? ahani "kechol chukkat happesach" litfila bealma.

Verabbi yose may tama? dichtiv barishon: "bemichsat nefashot" — vaafillu ishsha, uchetiv befesach sheni: "venichreta hannefesh hahiv meammeha", nefesh — vaafillu nashim. veella: "cheto yissa haish hahu", lemaote may? lemaote katan mikkaret.
Verabbi shimon: ketiv barishon "ish", ish — in, ishsha — la. vechi tema, i hachi afillu tefila name la? ahani leh "bemichsat nefashot" litfila.

Vechi tema, afillu bashsheni name. miet rachamana bashsheni, dichtiv: "cheto yissa haish", ish — in, ishsha — la. mimmay kammaet leh? i mechiyyuv — hasheta barishon la, bashsheni mibbaya? ella lav, mittefila.
Umay "ish" dekaamar rabbi shimon? i nema: "veyikchu lahem ish se levet avot vegomer" — hahu mibbee leh lechidrabbi yitzchak, deamar: ish zoche, veen katan zoche.
Veella "meish lefi ochlo", ha midderabbi yose savar la kerabbi shimon, rabbi shimon name savar la kerabbi yose, vehahu mibbee leh deshochatin et happesach al hayyachid.
Amar lach: im ken nichtov rachamana "lefi ochlo". may "ish" — shamat minna tarte.

Keman azla ha deamar rabbi elazar: ishsha barishon chova uvashsheni reshut, vedoche et hashshabbat. i reshut, ammay doche et hashshabbat? ella ema: bashsheni reshut uvarishon chova, vedoche et hashshabbat. keman — kerabbi yehuda.
Amar rabbi yaakov amar rabbi yochanan: en osin chavura shekkullah gerim, shemma yedakdeku bo viviuhu lide pesul.
Tanu rabbanan: pesach umatztza umaror, barishon — chova, mikkan veelach — reshut, rabbi shimon omer: baanashim chova uvannashim reshut.
Aheyay kae? illema appesach, pesach kol shiva mi ikka? veella ammatztza umaror, ema sefa: rabbi shimon omer: baanashim chova uvenashim reshut,

Let leh lerabbi shimon ha deamar rabbi elazar: nashim chayyayvot baachilat matztza devar tora, shenneemar: "lo tochal alav chametz shivat yamim tochal alav matztzot" — kol sheyyeshno beval tochal chametz, yeshno bekum echol matztza. vehane nashim, hoil veyeshnan beval tochal chametz, yeshnan bekum echol matztza!
Ella ema: pesach matztza umaror, barishon — chova, mikkan veelach — reshut. rabbi shimon omer: pesach baanashim chova, bannashim reshut.
Mishna onen — tovel veochel et pischo laerev, aval lo bakkodashim. hashshomea al meto,

a: Vehamelakket lo atzamot — tovel veochel bakkodashim.
Ger shennitgayyer beerev pesach, bet shammay omrim: tovel veochel et pischo laerev, uvet hillel omrim: happoresh min haorla keforesh min hakkever.
Gemara may tama? ka savar aninut delayla derabbanan, vegabbe pesach lo heemidu divrehem bimkom karet, gabbe kadashim haamidu divrehem bimkom ase.
Hashshomea al meto vechulei. melakket atzamot? ha bae hazzaat shelishi ushevii! ema: shellikketu lo atzamot.
Ger shennitgayyer vechulei. amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: machaloket bearel goy,

Devet hillel savri: gezera shemma yittame leshana habbaa, veyomar: eshtakad, mi lo tavalti veachalti? achshav name etbol veochal. vela yada deeshtakad — goy hava vela mekabbel tumea, achshav — yisrael umekabbel tumea.
Uvet shammay savri: la gazrinan. aval arel yisrael — divre hakkol tovel veochel et pischo laerev, vela gazrinan arel yisrael mishshum arel goy.

Tanya name hachi, amar rabbi shimon ben elazar: lo nechleku bet shammay uvet hillel al arel yisrael shettovel veochel et pischo laerev, al ma nechleku — al arel goy. shebbet shammay omrim: tovel veochel et pischo laerev, uvet hillel omrim: happoresh min haorla keforesh min hakkever.
Amar rava: arel hazzaa veizmel — heemidu divrehen bimkom karet. onen umetzora uvet happeras — lo heemidu divrehen bimkom karet.
Arel — ha daamaran.
Hazzaa — deamar mar: hazzaa shevut veeno doche et hashshabbat.
Izmel — detanya: keshem sheen meviin oto derech reshut harabbim, kach en meviin oto derech gaggot vederech chatzerot vederech karpefot.
Onen — ha daamaran.
Metzora — may hi? detanya: metzora shechal shemini shello beerev happesach, veraa keri bo bayyom — tovel veochel.
Amru chachamim: af al pi shettevul yom eno nichnas, ze nichnas. mutav yavo ase sheyyesh bo karet, veyidche ase sheen bo karet.

Veamar rabbi yochanan: devar tora afillu ase en bo, shenneemar: "vayyaamod yehoshafat bikhal yehuda virushalaym bevet Adonai lifne hechatzer hachadasha", may chatzer hachadasha? shechiddeshu bo davar, veamru: tevul yom lo yikkanes bemachane leviyya.
Bet happeras, ditnan: veshavin bet shammay uvet hillel
b: Shebbodkin leose fesach, veen bodkin leochle teruma.
May bodkin (leose pesach)? amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: menappeach bet happeras veholech. rav yehuda bar abbaye mishshemeh derav yehuda amar: bet happeras shenniddash tahor.
Hadaran alach haishsha

Mishna mi shehaya tame o bederech rechoka velo asa et harishon — yaase et hashsheni. shagag o neenas velo asa et harishon — yaase et hashsheni. im ken, lamma neemar tame o shehaya bederech rechoka? sheellu peturin mehikkaret, veellu chayyayvin behikkaret.

Gemara ittemar: haya bederech rechoka ushechato vezarku alav, rav nachman amar: huretza. rav sheshet amar: lo huretza. rav nachman amar: huretza, mechas hu dechas rachamana alav. vei aved — tavo alav beracha. verav sheshet amar: lo huretza, midche dachyeh rachamana ketame.
Amar rav nachman: mena amena la, ditnan: mi shehaya tame o bederech rechoka velo asa et harishon — yaase et hashsheni. mikkelal dei bae — aved.
Verav sheshet amar lach: i hachi, sefa dekatane: shagag o neenas velo asa et harishon — yaase et hashsheni. middekatane "velo asa", mikkelal dei bae — aved. hare shagag, vahare neenas!
Ella, mezid katane bahadayyhu. hacha name: onen katane bahadayyhu.
Amar rav ashe: matnitin name dayka, dekatane: ellu peturin mehikkaret veellu chayyayvin behikkaret. aheyay? illema ashshogeg veneenas, shogeg veneenas bene charet ninhu?! ella lav — ammezid veonen.
Verav nachman amar lach: leolam ammezid lechodeh. uvedin hu deibbei leh lemitne "chayyayv", vehay dekatane "chayyayvin" — ayyeyde ditna resha "peturin", tena sefa "chayyayvin".
Amar rav sheshet: mena amena la? detanya, rabbi akiva omer: neemar "tame", veneemar "bederech rechoka",

a: Ma tame, shessippek beyado laasot veeno ose. af derech rechoka name, shessippek beyado laasot veeno ose!
Verav nachman amar lach: rabbi akiva letameh, dekasavar: en shochatin vezorkin al teme sheretz. vaana sevira li keman deamar: shochatin vezorkin al teme sheretz.
Tanu rabbanan, ellu sheosin et hashsheni: hazzavin vehazzavot, hametzorain vehametzoraot, [veniddot] uvoale niddot vehayyoldot, hashshoggin vehaanusin vehammezidin, vetame veshehaya bederech rechoka.
Im ken lamma neemar "tame"? lamma neemar?! dei bae lemibad barishon la shavkinan leh! ella: im ken, lamma neemar "bederech rechoka" — lefotro min hikkaret. ucheman deamar huretza.
