Ishsha bashsheni mi michayyeyva? veha tanya: yachol lo yehu osin et hashsheni ella teme nefesh veshehaya bederech rechoka. zavin umetzorain uvoale niddot minnayin? talmud lomar: "ish ish".
La kashya: ha — rabbi yose, ha — rabbi yehuda verabbi shimon.

Tanu rabbanan: chayyayv karet al harishon, vechayyayv karet al hashsheni, divre rabbi. rabbi natan omer: chayyayv karet al harishon, ufatur al hashsheni. rabbi chananya ben akavya omer: af [al] harishon eno chayyayv karet ella im ken lo asa et hashsheni.

Veazdu letamayyhu. detanya: ger shennitgayyer ben shene fesachim, vechen katan shehigdil ben shene fesachim — chayyayv laasot pesach sheni, divre rabbi. rabbi natan omer: kol shezzakuk larishon — zakuk lashsheni, kol sheen zakuk larishon — en zakuk lashsheni.
Bemay kamippalgi? rabbi savar: sheni regel bifne atzmo hu.
Rabbi natan savar: sheni tashlumin derishon hu. takkone larishon, la metakken leh.
Verabbi chananya ben akavya savar: sheni takkanta derishon hu.

Usheloshtan mikra echad darshu: "vehaish asher hu tahor uvederech lo haya". rabbi savar: "vechadal laasot happesach venichreta", dela avad barishon, i name: "korban Adonai lo hikriv bemoado", bashsheni.
Umimmay (deha) "cheto yissa" karet hu?
b: Kasavar: megaddef hayeynu mevarech hashshem, uchetiv bimvarech et hashshem "venasa cheto".
Vegamar hay "cheto" dehacha, mecheto" dehatam: ma lehallan karet, af kan name karet.
Verabbi natan savar: "vechadal laasot happesach venichreta", dehay "ki" — leshon deha hu, vehachi kaamar rachamana: deha "korban Adonai lo hikriv bemoado" barishon.
Hay "cheto yissa" may aved leh? kasavar: megaddef lav hayeynu mevarech et hashshem, vegamar hay "cheto" dehatam mehay "cheto" dehacha. ma hacha karet — af hatam karet.
Verabbi chananya ben akavya savar: "vechadal laasot happesach venichreta", i "korban Adonai lo hikriv bemoado" — bashsheni.
Vehay "cheto yissa" may aved leh? kedaamaran.
Hilkach: hezid baze uvaze — divre hakkol chayyayv, shagag baze uvaze — divre hakkol patur.
Hezid barishon veshagag bashsheni, lerabbi ulerabbi natan — michayyeyvi, lerabbi chananya ben akavya — patur.
Shagag barishon vehezid bashsheni, lerabbi — chayyayv. lerabbi natan ulerabbi chananya ben akavya — patur.

Mishna ezo hi derech rechoka? min hammodiim velachutz, uchemiddatah lechol ruach, divre rabbi akiva. rabbi eliezer omer: meiskuppat haazara velachutz. amar leh rabbi yose: lefichach nakud al Adonai, lomar: la mippene sherachok vadday, ella meiskuppat haazara velachutz.

Gemara amar ulla: min hammodiim lirushalayim chamishsha asar milin havya. savar la ki ha deamar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: kamma mahalach adam bayyom — asara parsaot: mealot hashshachar vead hanetz hachamma chameshet milin, mishshekiat hachamma vead tzet hakkochavim chameshet milin. pashu le telatin: chamesar mitztzafra lefalga deyoma, vachamesar mippalga deyoma leureta.
Ulla letameh, deamar ulla: e ze hu derech rechoka? kol sheen yachol likkanes bishat shechita.

Amar mar: mealot hashshachar ad hanetz hachamma chameshet milin, mena lan? dichtiv: "uchemo hashshachar ala vayyaitzu hammalachim vegomer", uchetiv: "hashshemesh yatza al haaretz velot ba tzoara". veamar rabbi chanina: ledidi chaze li hahu atra vehavya chamishsha milin.
Gufa, amar ulla: eze hu derech rechoka? kol sheen yachol likkanes bishat shechita. verav yehuda amar: kol sheen yachol likkanes bishat achila.

Amar leh rabba leulla: ledidach kashya ulerav yehuda kashya. ledidach kashya, deamrat: kol sheen yachol likkanes bishat shechita, veha teme sheretz — deen yachol likkanes bishat shechita, vekaamrat: shochatin vezorkin al teme sheretz.
Ulerav yehuda kashya, deamar: kol sheen yachol likkanes bishat achila, veha teme sheretz — deyachol likkanes bishat achila, vekaamar: en shochatin vezorkin al teme sheretz!
Amar leh: la ledidi kashya vela lerav yehuda kashya. ledidi la kashya: derech rechoka lattahor, veen derech rechoka lattame.

a: Lerav yehuda la kashya: teme sheretz rachamana dachyeh, dichtiv: "ish ish ki yihye tame lanefesh", mi la askinan shechal shevii shello lihyot beerev happesach, vaafillu hachi amar rachamana — liddeche.
Tanu rabbanan: haya omed chutz lammodiim, veyachol likkanes besusim uvifradim, yachol yehe chayyayv — talmud lomar: "uvederech lo haya", vehalla haya badderech.
Haya omed lifnim min hammodiim, veen yachol likkanes mippene gemallim ukeronot hameakkevot oto, yachol lo yehe chayyayv — talmud lomar: "uvederech lo haya", vahare lo haya badderech.
Amar rava: shitta alfe parse have alma, vesumecha dirkia alpa parse. chada gemara, vachada sevara.

Savar la ki ha deamar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: kamma mahalach adam benoni bayyom — eser parsaot: mealot hashshachar vead hanetz hachamma chamishsha milin, mishshekiat hachamma ad tzet hakkochavim chamishsha milin, nimtza ovyo shel rakia echad mishshishsha bayyom.

Metivi, rabbi yehuda omer: ovyo shel rakia echad measara bayyom. teda, kamma mahalach adam benoni bayyom — eser parsaot, umealot hashshachar ad hanetz hachamma arbaat milin, mishshekiat hachamma vead tzet hakkochavim arbaat milin, nimtzet ovyo shel rakia echad measara bayyom. teyuveta derava, teyuveta deulla. teyuveta.
Lema tehve teyuveta derabbi yochanan? amar lach: ana bimama hu daamari, verabbanan hu deka tau, deka chashvin dekadma vachashocha.
Lema tehve teyuveta derabbi chanina? la, "vayyaitzu" shane.

Ta shema: mitzrayim haya arba meot parsa al arba meot parsa, umitzrayim echad mishshishshim bechush, vechush echad mishshishshim baolam, veolam echad mishshishshim baggan, vegan echad mishshishshim beeden, veeden echad mishshishshim begehinnam, nimtza kol haolam kullo kechissuy kedera legehinnam. teyuveta.

Ta shema, detana deve eliyyahu, rabbi natan omer: kol hayyishshuv kullo tachat kochav echad yoshev. teda, shehare adam noten eno bechochav echad, holech lammizrach — omed kenegdo, learba ruchot haolam — omed kenegdo, mikkelal dechol hayyishshuv kullo tachat kochav echad yoshev. teyuveta.

Ta shema: agala batztzafon, veakrav baddarom, vechol hayyishshuv kullo eno yoshev ella ben agala leakrav. vechol hayyishshuv kullo eno hove ella shaa achat bayyom, sheen chamma nichneset layyishshuv ella shaa achat bayyom.
Teda, shebbechamesh chamma bammizrach, uvesheva chamma bammaarav, chatzi shesh vachatzi sheva chamma omedet berosh kol adam. teyuveta.
Ta shema, deamar rabban yochanan ben zakkay: ma teshuva heshivattu bat kol leoto rasha beshaa sheamar "eele al bomote av eddamme leelyon", yatzta bat kol veamra lo: rasha ben rasha,
b: Ben beno shel nimrod harasha, shehimrid et kol haolam kullo alay bemalchuto. kamma shenotav shel adam? shivim shana, veim bigvurot — shemonim shana, shenneemar: "yeme shenotenu vahem shivim shana veim bigvurot shemonim shana",

Min haaretz ad larakia mahalach chamesh meot shana, veovyo shel rakia mahalach chamesh meot shana, uven (kol) rakia lerakia mahalach chamesh meot shana, vechen ben kol rakia verakia, "ach el sheol turad el yarkete vor". teyuveta.

Tanu rabbanan, chachme yisrael omrim: galgal kavua, umazzalot chozrin. vechachme ummot haolam omrim: galgal chozer, umazzalot kevuin. amar rabbi: teshuva ledivrehem — meolam lo matzinu agala baddarom veakrav batztzafon.
Matkef la rav acha bar yaakov: vedilma kevutzina derichya. i name ketzinnora dedashsha.

Chachme yisrael omrim: bayyom chamma mehallechet lematta min harakia, uvallayla lemala min harakia. vechachme ummot haolam omrim: bayyom chamma mehallechet lematta min harakia, uvallayla lematta min hakkarka. amar rabbi: venirin divrehen middevarenu, shebbayyom maayanot tzonnin, uvallayla rotchin.

Tanya rabbi natan omer: bimot hachamma, chamma mehallechet begova shel rakia, lefichach kol haolam kullo roteach umaayanot tzonnin. bimot haggeshamim, chamma mehallechet beshippule rakia, lefichach kol haolam kullo tzonen umaayanot rotchin.

Tanu rabbanan: bearbaa shevilin chamma mehallechet. nisan iyyayr vesivan — mehallechet beharim, kede lefashsher et hashshelagin. tammuz av veelul — mehallechet bayyishshuv, kede levashshel et happerot. tishre merachshevan vechislev — mehallechet bayyammim, kede leyabbesh et hanneharot. tevet shevat vaadar — mehallechet bammidbar, shello leyabbesh et hazzeraim.
Verabbi eliezer omer meiskuppat kulei. veaf al gav dematze ayel, vela amrinan leh kum eyel?! vehatanya: yehudi arel shello mal — anush karet, divre rabbi eliezer.
Amar abbaye: derech rechoka lattahor, veen derech rechoka lattame.
Rava amar, tannae hi. detanya, rabbi eliezer omer: neemar richuk makom bappesach, veneemar richuk makom bammaaser. ma lehallan chutz laachilato, af kan chutz laachilato.
Rabbi yose bar rabbi yehuda omer mishshum rabbi eliezer: chutz laasiyyayto.
Keman azla ha deamar rabbi yitzchak bar rav yosef: bitmeim hallech achar rov haomdin baazara. keman — kerabbi yose bar rabbi yehuda sheamar mishshum rabbi eliezer.

Amar lo rabbi yose: lefichach vechulei. tanya, rabbi yose haggelili omer: "derech", shomea ani mahalach shenayim o shelosha yamim, keshehu omer "uvederech lo haya", maggid shemmeiskuppat haazara velachutz karuy derech.

a: Mishna ma ben pesach harishon lashsheni? harishon asur beval yerae" uval yimmatze", vehashsheni — chametz umatztza immo babbayit. harishon taun hallel baachilato, vehashsheni eno taun hallel baachilato. ze vaze taun hallel baasiyyaytan, veneechalin tzali al matztza umerorim, vedochin et hashshabbat.
Gemara tanu rabbanan: "kechol chukkat happesach yaasu oto" — bemitzva shebbegufo hakkatuv medabber.

Mitzva sheal gufo, minnayin? talmud lomar: "al matztzot umerorim yochluhu". yachol afillu mitzvot shello al gufo — talmud lomar: "veetzem lo yishberu vo", ma shevirat haetzem meyuchad mitzva shebbegufo — af kol mitzva shebbegufo.
Isi ben yehuda omer: "yaasu oto", bemitzvot shebbegufo hakkatuv medabber.
Amar mar: yachol af mitzva shello al gufo. ha amrat bemitzva shebbegufo hakkatuv medabber?
Hachi kaamar: hasheta deamrat "al matztzot umerorim yochluhu", alma "yaasu oto" lav davka hu. ema have leh kifrat uchelal, venaasa kelal mosif al happerat, vaafillu kol mille name, ka mashma lan.
Isi ben yehuda, hay "etzem" may aved leh? mibbee leh leechad etzem sheyyesh bo moach, veechad etzem sheen bo moach.
Verabbanan, hay "yaasu oto" may avdi leh? mibbee leh sheen shochatin et happesach al hayyachid, dechamma deefshar leahdore mahderinan.

Tanu rabbanan: "kechol chukkat happesach yaasu oto". yachol keshem sheharishon asur beval yerae" uval yimmatze" kach sheni asur beval yerae" uval yimmatze" — talmud lomar: "al matztzot umerorim yochluhu".
Veen li ella mitzvat ase, mitzvat lo taase minnayin? talmud lomar: "lo yashiru mimmennu ad boker".

Veen li ella mitzvat lo taase shennittak laase. mitzvat lo taase gamur minnayin? talmud lomar: "veetzem lo yishberu vo". ma happerat — meforash: mitzvat ase, velo taase shennittak laase, velo taase gamur — af kol mitzvat ase, velo taase shennittak laase, velo taase gamur.
Bichlaleh dematztzot umerorim", may ka merabbe? tzeli esh. bifrateh may memaet leh? hashebatat seor. efoch ana! mitzva degufeh adif.
Bichlaleh delo yashiru mimmennu ad boker" may ka merabbe leh? "lo totzi mimmennu" (dedame leh. dehay mippesal benotar, vehay mippesal beyotze).
Bifrateh may ka memaet leh? "lo yerae velo yimmatze" (dedame leh, dehay eno loke dehave lav shennittak laase. vehay eno loka dehave leh lav shennittak laase). efoch ana! mitzva degufeh adif.
Bichlaleh deetzem lo yishberu vo"
b: May ka merabbe? "al tochlu mimmennu na". bifrateh may ka memaati? "lo tishchat al chametz dam zivchi". efoch ana! mitzva degufeh adif.

Harishon taun hallel baachilato vechulei. mena hane mille? amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yehotzadak: amar kera "hashshir yihye lachem kelel hitkaddesh chag". layla hamekuddash lechag — taun hallel, layla sheen mekuddash lechag — en taun hallel.
Ze vaze teunin hallel baasiyyaytan kulei. may tama? ibbaet ema: layla ka memaet, yom la ka memaet. veibbaet ema: efshar yisrael shochatin et pischehen venotlin et lulevehen, veen omrim hallel?!
Veneechalin tzali vechulei. shabbat in, tumea la. matnitin dela kerabbi yehuda. detanya: doche et hashshabbat, veen doche et hattumea. rabbi yehuda omer: af doche et hattumea.
May tama detanna kamma: mippene tumea dechitiv yachzor veyease betumea?! verabbi yehuda: hattora chazra alav laasoto betohora, lo zacha — yease betumea.
Tanu rabbanan: pesach rishon doche et hashshabbat, pesach sheni doche et hashshabbat. pesach rishon doche et hattumea, pesach sheni doche et hattumea. pesach rishon taun lina, pesach sheni taun lina.
Doche et hattumea, keman? kerabbi yehuda.

Ulerabbi yehuda taun lina? veha tanya, rabbi yehuda omer: minnayin lefesach sheni sheen taun lina, shenneemar: "ufanita vabboker vehalachta leohalecha", uchetiv: "sheshet yamim tochal matztzot", hanneechol leshishsha taun lina, sheen neechol leshishsha — en taun lina!
Tere tannae veallibba derabbi yehuda.
Mishna happesach shebba betumea, lo yochlu mimmennu zavin vezavot niddot veyoldot. veim achlu — peturin mikkaret.
Verabbi eliezer poter af al biat mikdash.

Gemara tanu rabbanan: zavin vezavot niddot veyoldot sheachlu befesach shebba betumea, yachol yehu chayyayvin — talmud lomar: "kol tahor yochal basar. vehannefesh asher tochal basar mizzevach hashshelamim asher laAdonai vetumeato alav venichreta".
Neechal lithorim — chayyayvim alav mishshum tame, vesheeno neechol lithorin — en temein chayyayvin alav mishshum tame.

Rabbi eliezer omer: yachol dachaku zavin venichnesu laazara befesach habba betumea, yachol yehu chayyayvin — talmud lomar: "vishallechu min hammachane kol tzarua vechol zav vechol tame lanafesh", bizman shettemee metim mishtallechin — zavin umetzorain mishtallechin, en temee metim mishtallechin — en zavin umetzorain mishtallechin.

Bae rav yosef: dachaku temee metim venichnesu lahechol befesach habba betumea, mahu? middeishteray tumeat azara ishteray name tumeat hechol, o dilma may deishteray — ishteray, may dela ishteray — la ishteray!
Amar rava, amar kera: "vishallechu min hammachane", afillu miktzat machane.

Ikka deamri: amar rava, amar kera: "vishallechu min hammachane ... el michutz lammachane teshallechum", kol hecha dekarenan beh "el michutz lammachane teshallechum" — karenan beh "vishallechu min hammachane".
Bae rav yosef: dachaku temee metim veachlu emure pesach habba betumea,

a: Mahu? middeishteray tumeat basar — ishteray name tumeat emurin, o dilma: may deishteray — ishteray, may dela ishteray — la ishteray.
Amar rava: mikkede tumeat emurin mehecha itrabbay — mittumeat basar, dichtiv: "asher laAdonai", lerabbot et haemurin.
Kol hecha deiteh letumeat basar, iteh letumeat emurin. kol hecha deleteh letumeat basar, leteh letumeat emurin.
Bae rabbi zera: emure pesach mitzrayim hecha akterinhu? amar leh abbaye: uman lema lan dela sheviske avud?
Veod, ha tena rav yosef: shelosha mizbechot hayu sham: al hammashkof, veal shete hammezuzot. vetu midde acharina la hava.

Mishna ma ben pesach mitzrayim lefesach dorot? pesach mitzrayim mikkacho mibbeasor, vetaun hazzaa baaguddat ezov, veal hammashkof veal shete hammezuzot, veneechol bechippazon, ballayla echad. ufesach dorot noheg kol shiva.
Gemara mena lan? dichtiv: "dabberu el kol adat yisrael lemor beasor lachodesh hazze veyikchu". ze mikkacho mibbeasor, veen pesach dorot mikkacho mibbeasor.
Ella meatta: "vehaya lachem lemishmeret ad arbaa asar yom lachodesh hazze", hachi name — ze taun bikkur arbaa yamim kodem shechita, veen acher taun bikkur?

Vehatanya, ben bag bag omer: minnayin letamid shettaun bikkur arbaa yamim kodem shechita, shenneemar: "tishmeru lehakeriv li bemoado", ulehallan hu omer: "vehaya lachem lemishmeret ad arbaa asar", ma lehallan taun bikkur arbaa yamim kodem shechita, af kan taun bikkur arbaa yamim kodem shechita!
Shane hatam, dichtiv: "tishmeru".
Ufesach dorot name, hachtiv: "veavadta et haavoda hazzot bachodesh hazze", sheyyehu kol avodot chodesh ze — kaze.
Ella hahu "hazze" — lemaote pesach sheni dichvoteh.
Ella meatta dichtiv: "veachlu et habbasar ballayla hazze", hachi name deze neechol ballayla, veen acher neechol ballayla?! amar kera: "veavadta et haavoda".
Ella "hazze" lema li? lechidrabbi elazar ben azarya verabbi akiva.
Ella meatta dichtiv: "vechol arel lo yochal bo", hachi name devo" eno ochel, aval ochel befesach dorot?! amar kera: "veavadta".
Ella, "bo" lema li? devo" eno ochel, aval hu ochel bematztza umaror.
Ella meatta: "(vechol) ben nechar lo yochal bo", hachi name devo" eno ochel, aval ochel hu pesach ledorot?! amar kera: "veavadta".
Ella, "bo" lema li? "bo" meshummadut poselet, veen meshummadut poselet bitruma.

Veitzterich lemichtav "arel", veitzterich lemichtav "ben nechar". dei ketav rachamana "arel", mishshum dimis, aval ben nechar la meis — ema la, tzericha. vei ashmeinan "ben nechar", mishshum deen libbo lashshamayim, aval arel delibbo lashshamayim — ema la, tzericha.

Ella meatta: "toshav vesachir lo yochal bo", hachi name devo" hu eno ochel, aval ochel hu befesach dorot?! amar kera: "veavadta". ella "bo" lema li? "bo" meshummadut poselet, veen meshummadut poselet bitruma.

Ella meatta: "umalta oto az yochal bo", hachi name devo" eno ochel, aval ochel befesach dorot?! amar kera: "veavadta". ella "bo" lema li? "bo" milat zecharav vaavadav meakkevet, veen milat zecharav vaavadav meakkevet bitruma.
Ella meatta dichtiv: "veetzem lo yishberu bo", hachi name devo" eno shover, aval shover befesach dorot?! amar kera: "veavadta". ella "bo" lema li? "bo" bechasher, velo befasul.
Ella meatta dichtiv: "al tochlu mimmennu na", "mimmennu" i atta ochel, aval atta ochel na befesach dorot?! amar kera: "veavadta". ella "mimmennu" lema li? lechidrabba amar rabbi yitzchak.
Veneechol bechippazon vechulei. mena lan? deamar kera: "vaachaltem oto bechippazon". "oto" neechol bechippazon, veen acher neechol bechippazon.
Ufesach dorot noheg kol shiva vechulei. ammay kae? i lema appesach, pesach kol shiva mi ikka!
b: Ella achametz. mikkelal defesach mitzrayim layla echad vetu la? vehatanya, rabbi yose haggelili omer: minnayin lefesach mitzrayim sheen chimmutzo noheg ella yom echad — talmud lomar: "lo yeachel chametz", usemich leh: "hayyom attem yotzim".
Ella hachi kaamar: layla echad, vehu haddin lefesach dorot. vechimmutzo kol hayyom, ufesach dorot noheg kol shiva.
Mishna amar rabbi yehoshua: shamati shettemurat pesach kereva, utemurat pesach enah kereva, veen li lefaresh.
Amar rabbi akiva, ani afaresh: happesach shennimtza kodem shechitat happesach — yire ad sheyyistaev, veyimmacher, veyavi bedamav shelamim. vechen temurato.
Achar shechitat happesach — karev shelamim. vechen temurato.
Gemara velema: pesach karev ufesach eno karev. ha ka mashma lan deikka temurat happesach dela karva.
Ittemar, rabba amar: kodem shechita uleachar shechita shaninu. rabbi zera amar: kodem chatzot uleachar chatzot shaninu.
Ulerabbi zera, ha katane kodem shechitat happesach? ema: kodem zeman shechitat happesach.
Ketannae. happesach shennimtza kodem shechita — yire, leachar shechita — yikrav. rabbi eliezer omer: kodem chatzot — yire, leachar chatzot — yikrav.

Achar shechitat happesach yavi shelamim vechulei. amar rava: lo shanu ella shennimtza achar shechita vehemir bo achar shechita. aval nimtza kodem shechita vehemir bo achar shechita — temurato mikkoach kedushsha dechuya ka ata, vela karva.
Etiveh abbaye: "im kesev", ma talmud lomar "im kesev"? lerabbot temurat happesach achar happesach shekkereva shelamim.
Hechi dame? illema shennimtza achar shechita vehemir bo achar shechita — peshita! lema li kera? ella lav, shennimtza kodem shechita vehemir bo achar shechita!
La, leolam shennimtza achar shechita vehemir bo achar shechita, ukera asmachta bealma.
Ella kera lemay ata? kidtanya: "kesev" lerabbot et happesach lealya.
Keshehu omer "im kesev", lerabbot pesach sheavra shenato, ushelamim habbain mechamat pesach lechol mitzvat shelamim, shettaun semicha unesachim utenufat chaze vashok.
Ucheshehu omer "veim ez" — hifsik hainyan, limmed al haez sheen teuna alya.
Ikka dematne la aresha: happesach shennimtza kodem shechitat happesach — yire ad sheyyistaev, veyimmacher, veyavi bedamav shelamim. vechen temurato.

Amar rava: lo shanu ella shennimtza kodem shechita vehemir bo kodem shechita, aval nimtza kodem shechita vehemir bo achar shechita — temurato kereva shelamim. may tama — ki kava shechita midde dachaze leh. midde dela chaze leh — la kava.
Etiveh abbaye: "im kesev", ma talmud lomar? lerabbot temurat happesach achar happesach shekkereva shelamim.

a: Yachol af lifne happesach ken? talmud lomar: "hu" — hu karev, veen temurat happesach kereva.
Hechi dame? illema shennimtza kodem shechita vehemir bo kodem shechita — peshita! lema li kera? ella lav, shennimtza kodem shechita vehemir bo achar shechita! teyuveta derava, teyuveta.

Amar shemuel: kol shebbachattat meta — bappesach karev shelamim, vechol shebbachattat roe — bappesach name roe. verabbi yochanan amar: en happesach karev shelamim ella shennimtza achar shechita, aval kodem shechita — lo.
Matkef la rav yosef: uchelala hu? vahare chattat sheavra shenatah, deliriyya azla, deamar rabbi shimon ben lakish: chattat sheavra shenatah — roin otah keillu hi omedet bevet hakkevarot, veroe.

Veillu befesach ki hay gavvna karev shelamim, detanya: "kesev", lerabbot et happesach lealya, keshehu omer: "im kesev", lerabbot et happesach sheavra shenato ushelamim habbain mechamat pesach lechol mitzvat shelamim, shetteunim semicha unesachim utenufat chaze vashok. keshehu omer: "im ez" — hifsik hainyan, limmed al haez sheen taun alya.
Amar leh: ki kaamar shemuel, baavudin. bidchuyin la amar.

Veavud mi mashkachat la? vahare avuda bishat haferasha, lerabbanan, deliriyya azla. ditnan: hifrish chattato veavda, vehifrish acheret tachteha venimtzet harishona, vahare shetehen omdot — achat mehen tikrav usheniyya tamut, divre rabbi. vachachamim omrim: en chattat meta ella shennimtzet leachar shennitkapperu bealim. ha kodem shennitkapperu bealim — roa.
Veillu befesach, hecha deavad venimtza achar chatzot kodem shechita — karev shelamim. shemuel kerabbi sevira leh, deamar avuda lemita azla.
Veha kol avuda lerabbi meta, veillu befesach hecha deavad kodem chatzot venimtza kodem chatzot — roe! kodem chatzot lav avud hu, kidrava, deamar rava: avedat layla lav shemah aveda.
Ella, roa lerabbi hechi mashkachat la?
b: Kidrabbi oshaya. deamar rabbi oshaya: hifrish shete chattaot leachrayut — mitkapper beachat mehen, usheniyya tire.
Veha illu befesach ki hay gavvna karev shelamim! ella shemuel kerabbi shimon sevira leh, deamar: chamesh chattaot metot.
Veha roa lerabbi shimon let leh kelal! shemuel name chada kaamar: kol shebbachattat meta — befesach karev shelamim.
Umay ka mashma lan? leappoke midderabbi yochanan, deamar: en happesach karev shelamim ella shennimtza achar shechita, aval kodem shechita — la. alma: shechita kava. ka mashma lan: chatzot kava.
Lishshana acharina: veillu befesach hecha deavad venimtza achar chatzot, kodem shechita yikrav shelamim! shemuel kerabba sevira leh, deamar: shechita kava.
Veha middekaamar rabbi yochanan ala: en happesach karev shelamim ella shennimtza achar shechita, aval kodem shechita — la. alma: shechita kava. mikkelal dishmuel savar: chatzot kava.

Ella: shemuel kerabbi sevira leh, deamar: avuda lemita azla. veha kol avudin lerabbi metin, veillu befesach, hecha deavad kodem chatzot venimtza kodem chatzot — roe! kasavar: kodem chatzot lav avud hu, vekasavar chatzot kava.
Mishna hammafrish nekeva lefischo, o zachar ben shete shanim — yire ad sheyyistaev, veyimmacher, veyippelu damav lindava lishlamim.

a: Hammafrish pischo umet, lo yeviennu beno acharav leshem pesach ella leshem shelamim.
Gemara amar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua: shema minna telat. shema minna: baale chayyim nidchin.
Ushema minna: dachuy meikkara have dachuy. ushema minna: yesh dichuy bedamim.

Hammafrish pischo vechulei. tanu rabbanan: hammafrish et pischo umet, im beno memunne immo yeviennu leshum pesach, en beno memunne immo — yeviennu leshum shelamim leshishsha asar. leshishsha asar in, lachamishsha asar — la. ka savar: nedarim unedavot en kerevin beyom tov.
Demit haav emat? illema demit kodem chatzot, beno memunne immo yeviennu leshum pesach? ha chala aninut illaveh meikkara!
Ella demit achar chatzot. en beno memunne immo — yeviennu leshum shelamim? ha kevateh chatzot!
Amar (rava): leolam demit kodem chatzot, umay yeviennu leshum pesach — leshum pesach sheni.
Abbaye amar, litzdadin katane: met achar chatzot — beno memunne immo yeviennu leshum pesach. met kodem chatzot — en beno memunne immo yeviennu leshum shelamim.
Rav sherevya amar: leolam demit leachar chatzot, uchegon shehaya aviv goses bachatzot.
Rav ashe amar: leolam demit leachar chatzot, verabbi shimon hi, deamar: en baale chayyim nidchin.
Ravina amar: kegon shehifrisho achar chatzot umetu bealim achar chatzot, veka savar chatzot kava.
Mishna happesach shennitarev bizvachim — kullan yiru ad sheyyistaavu, veyimmachru, veyavi bidme hayyafe shebbahen mimmin ze uvidme hayyafe shebbahen mimmin ze, [veyafsid] hammotar mibbeto.
Nitarev bivchorot, rabbi shimon omer: im chavurat kohanim — yochelu.
b: Gemara veha ka mayyte kadashim levet happesul?
Rabbi shimon letameh, deamar: meviin kadashim levet happesul. ditnan: asham shennitarev bishlamim — rabbi shimon omer: yishshachatu batztzafon, veyeachlu kachomer shebbahen.
Amru lo: en meviin kadashim levet happesul.
Verabbanan, hechi avdinan? amar rava: namtin lo ad sheyyumemu, veyavi behema shemena, velema: kol hecha deiteh lefesach — techul aleh dehay, veachel lehu betorat bechor baal mum.

Mishna chavura sheavad pischah veamru leechad "tze uvakkesh ushechot alenu", vehalach umatza veshachat, vehem lakchu veshachatu, im shello nishchat rishon — hu ochel mishshello, vehem ochlin immo mishshello. veim shellahen nishchat rishon — hem ochlin mishshellahen, vehu ochel mishshello.
Veim eno yadua eze mehen nishchat rishon, o sheshshachatu shenehem keechad — hu ochel mishshello, vehem enam ochlin immo, veshellahen yetze levet hasserefa. ufeturin millaasot pesach sheni.

Amar lahen: "im echarti — tzeu veshachatu alay". halach umatza veshachat, vehen lakchu veshachatu. im shellahen nishchat rishon — hen ochlin mishshellahen, vehu ochel immahen. veim shello nishchat rishon — hu ochel mishshello, vehen ochlin mishshellahem.
Veim eno yadua eze mehen nishchat rishon, o sheshshachatu shenehem keechad — hen ochlin mishshellahen, vehu eno ochel immahen. veshello yetze levet hasserefa, ufatur millaasot pesach sheni.
Amar lahen veamru lo — ochlin kullan min harishon. veim en yadua eze mehen nishchat rishon — shenehen yotzin levet hasserefa.
Lo amar lahen velo amru lo — en acharain ze laze.

Shete chavurot shennitarvu pischehen, ellu moshchin lahen echad veellu moshchin lahen echad. echad meellu ba lo etzel ellu, veechad meellu ba lo etzel ellu, vechach hem omrim: im shellanu hu happesach hazze — yadecha meshuchot mishshellecha venimneta al shellanu. veim shellecha hu happesach hazze — yadenu meshuchot mishshellanu venimnenu al shellach.
Vechen chamesh chavurot shel chamishsha chamishsha veshel asara asara — moshchin lahen echad mikkol chavura vachavura vechen hem omrim.
Shenayim shennitarvu pischehen — ze moshech lo echad veze moshech lo echad, ze memanne immo echad min hashshuk veze memanne immo echad min hashshuk,

Ze ba etzel ze, veze ba etzel ze, vechach hem omrim: im shelli hu pesach ze — yadecha meshuchot mishshellecha venimneta al shelli, veim shellecha hu pesach ze — yaday meshuchot mishshelli venimneti al shellach.
Gemara tanu rabbanan: amar lahen veamru lo — ochel min harishon. lo amar lahen velo amru lo — enan acharain ze laze.
